column1: # Map message and choice bodies that were not quoted in the scripts.
A tired man stands by the roadside. He seems distracted by something.
column2: 一个疲惫的男人站在路边。他似乎被什么分了神。

column1: The floor around the magic circle has practically been turned to charcoal. The damage is severe, but does not seem to be recent.
column2: 魔法阵周围的地板几乎被烧成了木炭。损坏很严重，但看来不是最近造成的。

column1: The man picks up his satchel and hefts it over his shoulder. Something falls off of his robes as he leaves.
column2: 男人提起挎包，扛上肩头。他离开时，有什么东西从他的长袍上掉了下来。

column1: There is a small bag of coins stashed underneath the bed.
column2: 床底下藏着一小袋钱币。

column1: This must belong to the man standing there. Best to leave it alone.
column2: 这一定是站在那儿那个男人的。最好别去动它。

column1: It might open with another attempt.
column2: 再试一次，也许就能打开。

column1: The lid finally gives, and the chest opens.
column2: 箱盖终于松了，箱子打开了。

column1: The lid of this chest has been practically fused shut due to decades of moisture and neglect.
column2: 这只箱子的盖子因几十年的潮湿与弃置，几乎黏死了。

column1: Shifting around these long forgotten remains, you find a handful of old coins.
column2: 你拨开这些久被遗忘的遗存，找到了一把旧钱币。

column1: The chest is empty, and has been sitting unused long enough to have collected a thick layer of dust.
column2: 箱子是空的，闲置得够久，积了一层厚灰。

column1: The empty chest is rotting and has started to grow some questionable mushrooms.
column2: 空箱子正在腐烂，还开始长出一些不大妙的蘑菇。

column1: The empty wooden chest has started to rot from exposure to the elements.
column2: 空木箱因日晒雨淋，已经开始腐烂。

column1: There are ruins of long-abandoned buildings and disused roads surrounding you, but the sounds of muffled voices from somewhere nearby suggest that you are no longer alone here.
column2: 四周是久已废弃的建筑废墟和弃用的道路，可附近某处传来闷住的人声，说明你在这儿已经不是独自一人。

column1: This is where you were drawn into the ghostly ruined town, and where you returned when you escaped it. You may be able to return if you stay the night here.
column2: 你就是在这里被拖进那座幽灵般的废镇，逃出来时也是回到这里。你若在这儿过夜，也许还能回去。

column1: While making your way through the dense forest, you come across a long abandoned campfire in a tiny clearing. Night is approaching quickly and the path is difficult to find, so you decide to rest here until dawn.
column2: 你穿过密林时，在一小块空地上遇见一处废弃已久的篝火。夜色很快降临，路也难寻，于是你决定在这儿歇到黎明。

column1: While on fire watch, you nod off for what must have been only an instant, but when you jolt awake, you find that the trees have receded. Your party sits in the middle of an ancient plaza.
column2: 守火时，你打了个盹，想必只有一瞬，可猛然惊醒时，你发现树木退开了。你的队伍坐在一座古老广场的中央。

column1: You find copious amounts of cobwebs among these ancient remains, but not much else.
column2: 你在这些古老的遗存里发现大量蛛网，除此之外没什么别的。

column1: You kindle the campfire in order to brighten the area a bit more.
column2: 你点燃篝火，好让四周再亮一点。

column1: Inside the water bath you see some unwashed cutlery, kitchenware, and tableware.
column2: 水槽里有一些没洗的刀叉餐具、厨具和食器。

column1: Rifling through the soft cushions, you discover a plain-looking key hidden underneath.
column2: 你在柔软的靠垫里翻找，发现底下藏着一把样子平平的钥匙。

column1: The tableware has been meticulously cleaned, so much so that you can see your reflection in each piece.
column2: 餐具被擦得极仔细，仔细到每一件都能照出你的影子。

column1: A corner juts out from beneath this stone. Giving it a little push, you find a small wooden coffer buried in the dirt.
column2: 一只角从这块石头底下探出来。你轻轻一推，发现一只小木匣埋在土里。

column1: It looks like this journal holds records for the activities of whoever worked here.
column2: 这本日志似乎记着曾在这儿干活的人做了些什么。

column1: On the top of this table, someone has scratched the phrase "I hate stupid girls".
column2: 有人在这张桌面上刻了一句：“我恨蠢女孩”。

column1: The box contains eight separate and carefully-wrapped parcels, each with a measured-out amount of gold in them. These must be the school funds mentioned in the work journal.
column2: 箱子里有八包各自仔细包好的东西，每一包都装着称量好的一份黄金。这些一定是工作日志里提到的学校经费。

column1: There is an old journal in this night table. Some of the entries are still legible. Would you like to read it?
column2: 这张床头柜里有一本旧日志。有些条目还读得出来。你要读吗？

column1: This chest has several different sized bits of cheap tin armour, evidently sized for children. It all looks very well-used.
column2: 这只箱子里有几件尺寸不一的廉价锡甲，显然是按孩子的尺寸做的。全都看得出用得很旧。

column1: This crumbling chest has a dozen or more lightweight wooden practice weapons, evidently as children's toys.
column2: 这只破箱子里有十多件轻巧的木制练习武器，显然是给孩子当玩具的。

column1: It reads : Entry is reserved for the bravest of souls.
column2: 上面写着：入内之权，仅留给最勇敢的灵魂。

column1: The chunk of slag you are carrying comes to mind. Will you place the Guardian Soul upon the pedestal?
column2: 你想起自己带着的那块熔渣。要把守卫之魂放上基座吗？

column1: The pedestal is hot to the touch. There is an inscription on the very top.
column2: 基座摸上去发烫。最顶上有一段铭文。

column1: You decide to hold on to the Guardian Soul for now. Perhaps it can be of use elsewhere.
column2: 你决定暂时留着守卫之魂。也许它在别处用得上。

column1: You make an offering of the Guardian Soul, a bit of slag forged from the destruction of many weapons.
column2: 你献上守卫之魂，那是一块由许多武器的毁灭锻成的熔渣。

column1: The smell is reminiscent of the fluid you found when you started exploring Arkasin.
column2: 这气味让你想起刚开始探索阿卡辛时找到的那种液体。

column1: There is a sculpture of a man here, buried halfway in the ground with his mouth gaping open in a silent scream. There is a brownish crust in two stripes down his body, as though there was something leaking from his eyes.
column2: 这里有一座男人的雕塑，半截埋在地里，嘴大张着，作无声的惨叫。他身上有两道褐色的硬壳，像是有什么从眼睛里漏了下来。

column1: There is an odd gurgling noise. From down the tunnel, there is a slight rush of air, a little fresher than you would expect. It seems you are not far from an exit.
column2: 有一种古怪的咕噜声。隧道那头有一阵轻微的气流，比你以为的要新鲜一点。看来你离出口不远了。

column1: You pour the foul-smelling fluid into the mouth of the statue. A moment later, it starts to weep out of the statue's eyes in a thick, slow-moving stream.
column2: 你把那股恶臭的液体倒进雕像的嘴里。片刻之后，它开始从雕像的眼睛里渗出来，又稠又慢。

column1: It is difficult to get a solid grip on the thing with all of the crust and slime interfering. Perhaps another attempt would prove more fruitful.
column2: 硬壳和黏液碍事，很难把这东西抓牢。再试一次，也许会更有结果。

column1: Looks like the remains of a traveller. He did not fare well.
column2: 看起来是一名旅人的遗骸。他的下场不好。

column1: The crate is full of paper and charcoal, probably meant to be sold or bartered. It is thoroughly spoiled with foul-smelling secretions from the floor and walls.
column2: 板条箱里装满纸和木炭，大概是用来卖或换的。地板和墙壁上恶臭的分泌物把它彻底泡坏了。

column1: The slime of this place has done quite a number on this chest, covering the whole thing with a dull, yellow crust. It'll take some forcing to get it open.
column2: 这地方的黏液把这只箱子糟蹋得不轻，整只箱子覆着一层暗淡的黄色硬壳。要打开它，得费些力气硬撬。

column1: There are a few articles of clothing in this sack. Most of it is soaked with the slime that covers everything else, but you do find what appears to be a bundle of linen.
column2: 这只袋子里有几件衣服。大部分都被覆盖一切的黏液浸透了，不过你确实找到了一捆像是亚麻布的东西。

column1: This satchel is full of rancid foodstuffs. They are clearly inedible, but there is an intact, sealed flask of wine tucked into the corner.
column2: 这只挎包里装满腐臭的食物。显然不能吃，可角落里塞着一只完好、封着口的酒壶。

column1: With a heave and a grunt and a crunching noise, the crust gives way and the chest opens, revealing what looks like a valuable drinking set with two different kinds of liquor.
column2: 你一使劲，闷哼一声，再一声碎裂，硬壳松开，箱子打开了，里面像是一套贵重的酒具，还有两种不同的酒。

column1: You carefully peel the slime-soaked linen away and find an unspoiled pair of fur boots. They are very nicely made, and were probably intended as trade goods.
column2: 你小心地剥开浸透黏液的亚麻布，找到一双完好的毛皮靴。做工非常好，大概是打算当货物交易的。

column1: Maybe now that they've worked it out of their systems, you can focus on stopping Vankan before he destroys the island.
column2: 也许现在他们把那股劲从身子里发泄掉了，你就能专心阻止 Vankan，赶在他毁掉这座岛之前。

column1: The smell is reminiscent of the fluid you found when you stuffed your face while exploring Arpa.
column2: 这气味让你想起你探索阿尔帕、狼吞虎咽时找到的那种液体。

column1: The thrumming of Arpa's pulse and the shifting of its walls make for a long, nauseating hour, but eventually Grant and Byrne return to you, both damp with sweat and exhausted.
column2: 阿尔帕的脉搏嗡鸣，墙壁不断挪移，凑成令人作呕的漫长一小时，可 Grant 和 Byrne 终于回到你身边，两人都汗津津的，筋疲力尽。

column1: You can't see what's going on, but every now and then you hear what you assume is an echo of Byrne's voice down the corridor.
column2: 你看不见里面在发生什么，可时不时能听见走廊那头的声音，你猜那是 Byrne 的回声。

column1: As you are returning the book, something else on the shelf catches your eye, something that looks like it doesn't belong there.
column2: 你把书放回去时，架子上另一样东西映入眼中，那样东西看起来不该在那儿。

column1: Gobble...
column2: 咕嘟……

column1: It seems your host dropped something as he left.
column2: 看来你的东道主离开时掉了什么东西。

column1: It suggests that the train has an on-board library. Perhaps more information could be located there.
column2: 它表明这趟列车上有一座图书馆。也许那儿能找到更多信息。

column1: Snap...
column2: 咔嚓……

column1: Snarf...
column2: 吸溜……

column1: There are a few leaflets here that are still in good enough shape to be legible.
column2: 这里有几张传单，保存得还够好，读得出来。

column1: There is a book that talks about the history of the Royal Transit System. It seems a bit long.
column2: 有一本书讲皇家运输系统的历史。看起来有点长。

column1: There is a key sitting forgotten on this table.
column2: 这张桌子上落着一把被人遗忘的钥匙。

column1: There is a trip planning guide here that appears to still be legible.
column2: 这里有一本行程规划指南，看起来还能读。

column1: There is little left but scraps of cloth on this mouldering corpse.
column2: 这具腐朽的尸体上几乎什么都不剩，只有几片布屑。

column1: There is nothing further of use on this corpse.
column2: 这具尸体上没有更多用得上的东西了。

column1: These leaflets are not in good condition. They've been heavily damaged by moisture, and are only partly legible.
column2: 这些传单状况不好。湿气把它们损得很重，只能读出一部分。

column1: This crate appears to contain a number of very old bottles. You find one that still has a tight seal on its cork.
column2: 这只板条箱里似乎有若干非常古老的瓶子。你找到一只软木塞仍然封得很紧的。

column1: This leaflet appears to contain some historical information about the "Royal Transit System", but it is hard to piece much of it together.
column2: 这张传单似乎载有一些关于“皇家运输系统”的历史信息，可很难拼出多少内容。

column1: Though the corpse is draped in nothing but rotting scraps of cloth, its hand is still tightly clutching a small metal object. Prying it loose, you find a small gold ring, still sparkling beneath its layer of greasy dirt.
column2: 尸体上只披着腐烂的布片，可它的手仍紧紧攥着一件小金属物。你把它撬开，发现一枚小金戒指，油腻的污垢底下依旧闪着光。

column1: What have you got there, now? The Sumptuous Garden"? I've never heard of this book. Let's see..."
column2: “你那儿拿的是什么？《奢华花园》？我从没听说过这本书。让我看看……”

column1: An orc woman retains this legal immunity for as long as she is capable of and willing to have more children. Any orc woman who has raised two daughters to adulthood shall enjoy this immunity for the rest of her life, regardless of her childbearing choices.
column2: 兽人女子只要仍有能力并愿意继续生育，便保留此项法律豁免。任何已将两名女儿抚养至成年的兽人女子，无论其后是否选择生育，终生享有此项豁免。

column1: An orc woman who has not yet raised two daughters and who is not currently raising a daughter who willfully destroys her ability to have children shall suffer death as punishment.
column2: 尚未将两名女儿抚养至成年、且当前并未在抚养女儿的兽人女子，若故意毁掉自己的生育能力，应处以死刑。

column1: An orc woman who has not yet raised two daughters shall be prohibited from engaging in any profession which prevents her from having children, or which presents a great risk of injury to her person.
column2: 尚未将两名女儿抚养至成年的兽人女子，禁止从事任何使她无法生育的职业，或对她的人身有造成伤害的极大风险的职业。

column1: Any boy or man whose actions directly or indirectly cause a woman to suffer death or damage to her ability to bear children shall suffer death as punishment.
column2: 任何男孩或男人，其行为直接或间接导致一名女子死亡，或损害她的生育能力，应处以死刑。

column1: Any orc woman who is capable of producing children is granted immunity to any legal reprimand that could influence her ability to produce or raise said children. This includes, but is not limited to, incarceration, execution, and most forms of capital punishment.
column2: 任何有能力生育的兽人女子，对任何可能影响她生育或抚养上述子女之能力的法律惩戒享有豁免。这包括但不限于监禁、处决，以及大多数形式的极刑。

column1: Due to the fact that birth rates of girls are very low in orcs, and the female portion of the population is only about ten percent, there are special provisions for protecting women and girls, even from the application of the law.
column2: 由于兽人的女婴出生率极低，女性仅约占人口的10%，因此有特别条款保护妇女与女孩，甚至使她们免受法律的施行。

column1: Give him your copy of "The Sumptuous Garden"?
column2: 把你的那本《奢华花园》给他？

column1: In all such cases, an orc man must serve the punishment in proxy. The man selected will be one deemed important to the woman, so as best to punish her for the indicted offense.
column2: 在所有此类情形中，必须由一名兽人男子代为受刑。被选中的男子应是被认为对那名女子重要的人，以便就所控之罪尽可能地惩罚她。

column1: In order to facilitate the birth of girls, any male children may at the mother's option be surrendered, permanently and without penalty, to military training schools where they will be raised to be productive members of Orc society. A monetary compensation will be provided to the mother for children surrendered in this fashion.
column2: 为促进女婴的出生，任何男孩均可依母亲的选择，永久且不受惩罚地交予军事训练学校，在那里被抚养为兽人社会中能作贡献的成员。以此方式交出的孩子，将向母亲提供金钱补偿。

column1: In response to the contentious issue of Glamig's responsibility for the Burntfoot March, an orc named Luc Beauregard was sentenced in proxy. Most people were insulted by this gesture - he was largely unknown and thus deemed to be of minimal worth to the Queen, and the fact that a proxy was given was a tacit admission of guilt.
column2: 针对 Glamig 对 Burntfoot进军所负责任这一争议，一名名叫 Luc Beauregard 的兽人被判处代刑。大多数人觉得这一姿态是种侮辱——他大体上默默无闻，因而被认为对女王几乎没什么价值，而给出代刑者这一事实，等于默认有罪。

column1: It is widely agreed that Glamig's decision to purge the beplagued township was shortsighted, and that the responsibility falls on her, but the question of how to deal with this is hotly debated.
column2: 人们普遍认为，Glamig 决定清洗那座染疫的市镇是短视的，责任在她，可如何处置此事却争论激烈。

column1: One party calls for her head, saying that only the Queen's execution can possibly atone for all the deaths she has caused, but another party, mainly proponents of traditional orcish laws, argue that Spartill must serve her punishment in proxy.
column2: 一派要求取她的人头，称唯有处决女王，才可能为她造成的所有死亡赎罪；另一派主要是传统兽人律法的支持者，主张必须由 Spartill 代她受刑。

column1: Spartill is popular with both parties, and is clearly not responsible for the issues at hand. The arguments put forth for both sides are passionate and heated. Accusations of racism are levied against both sides, with the human-led party calling for the Queen's death and the Orc-led party calling for the death of Spartill.
column2: Spartill 在两派中都很受欢迎，而且显然不对眼前的问题负责。双方提出的论点都激烈而火热。两边都被加上种族主义的指控：人类领导的一派要求处死女王，兽人领导的一派要求处死 Spartill。

column1: The author of these missives also details a dramatic increase of disappearances at sea, with the tides growing progressively less hospitable. The author speculates that Tsarath is somehow responsible for this, but fails to explain exactly how.
column2: 这些文书的作者还详述海上失踪急剧增加，潮汐也越来越不友善。作者推测察拉思对此负有某种责任，却没能说明究竟是如何造成的。

column1: The book says that Queen Glamig ordered a quarantine and a purge of the township. This decision was controversial, but the plague was contained, and the death toll was apparently minimal in comparison to the first plague.
column2: 书中说，女王 Glamig 下令对该镇实行隔离与清洗。这一决定有争议，但瘟疫被控制住了，死亡人数与第一次瘟疫相比显然少得多。

column1: The pamphlet goes on to mention that several prominent tailors have already begun vying for the prestigious honour of designing Her Royal Majesty's wedding dress. There are several flattering drawings of orc women wearing elaborate gowns, as the author hypothesizes on these tailors' trademark styles and what their gowns might look like.
column2: 小册子接着提到，几位著名裁缝已经开始争夺为女王陛下设计婚纱这一殊荣。上面有几幅兽人女子穿着繁复礼服的奉承画像，作者揣测着这些裁缝的招牌风格，以及他们的礼服会是什么样子。

column1: The populace became restless, and Queen Glamig Cosova was eventually beaten to death by an angry mob that arose in the capital. Many assumed that Spartill would arise to fill her position, but he had disappeared entirely, and the nations of Tsarath and Crest were now flooding in, both trying to gain power in the unrest.
column2: 民众变得躁动，女王 Glamig Cosova 最终被首都兴起的愤怒暴民殴打致死。许多人以为 Spartill 会站出来填补她的位置，可他已彻底消失，察拉思与克雷斯特两国正涌进来，都想在动乱中夺权。

column1: There is conjecture that this fact is quite vexing for other nations who would like to seize Lukatt's strategic position as a crossroads of several profitable trade routes.
column2: 有人揣测，这一事实令其他国家相当恼火，他们想夺取卢卡特作为数条利润丰厚的贸易路线交汇处的战略位置。

column1: This book appears to have transcripts of arguments held in the capital courts over how to appease the public for the events of The Burntfoot March.
column2: 这本书里似乎有首都法庭上的辩论记录，所争的是如何就 Burntfoot进军一事安抚公众。

column1: This book details a series of historic naval battles. Most of the accounts are sterile and matter-of-fact, but there is a proud declaration that Lukatt's navy is never defeated in their home waters, and judging by the records here, that appears to be true.
column2: 这本书详述一系列历史上的海战。大多数记述平淡而就事论事，但有一则自豪的宣告：卢卡特的海军在本方水域从未战败。照这里的记录看，这话似乎是真的。

column1: This book details the discovery of a plague outbreak in a small peat-mining township at the foot of the blackglass mountains. There had been another plague some thirty years prior, so many people still had vivid memories of the suffering it caused, and were scared of what a second plague could do to them.
column2: 这本书详述在黑璃山脉脚下一座小型泥炭开采镇发现瘟疫爆发的经过。大约30年前还有过一次瘟疫，所以许多人仍清晰记得它所造成的苦难，害怕第二次瘟疫会对他们做什么。

column1: This book details the way in which traditional orcish law is applied differently to men and women.
column2: 这本书详述传统兽人律法如何对男女区别适用。

column1: This book is detailing monetary losses and death counts. During the purge, fires spread to the peat mines and ignited them. This resulted in the destruction of the island's primary source of peat, the release of toxic gasses from deep underground, and an unpredictable wildfire that ran the breadth of the Knightwood forest.
column2: 这本书正详述着金钱损失与死亡人数。清洗期间，火势蔓延到泥炭矿并把它们点燃。结果岛上主要的泥炭来源被毁，地底深处释放出毒气，还有一场难以预测的野火烧遍了骑士林全境。

column1: This is not a formal printing so much as the ravings of a frantic author. He is detailing the beginning of a civil war on Lukatt.
column2: 与其说这是正式印刷品，不如说是一个狂乱作者的胡言。他正在详述卢卡特内战的开端。

column1: This pamphlet follows the announcement of Queen Glamig Cosova's betrothal to the popular war hero, Maxim Spartill. According to the pamphlet, the engagement is much-celebrated, as Spartill is well-loved with a long list of commendations and accomplishments.
column2: 这本小册子紧接着女王 Glamig Cosova 与广受欢迎的战争英雄 Maxim Spartill 订婚的公告。据小册子所说，这桩婚约大受庆贺，因为 Spartill 深受爱戴，嘉奖与功绩列了一长串。

column1: Thousands of people lost their lives or their homes to the fires directly, and thousands more fell to banditry, overcrowding, and exposure. The overall death count in the aftermath of what the author calls "The Burntfoot March" is much, much higher than the death count of both plagues combined.
column2: 数千人直接因火灾失去生命或家园，又有数千人死于抢劫、拥挤和露宿。作者称之为“Burntfoot进军”的那场事后，总死亡人数比两次瘟疫加起来还要高得多，高得多。

column1: Vankan flips open to the middle of the book and reads a passage.
column2: Vankan 把书翻到中间，读了一段。

column1: A bright blue light radiates out from between the planks and hinges of this wooden box.
column2: 一道明亮的蓝光从这只木箱的板缝和铰链之间透出来。

column1: A dark red ruby sits inside the drawer. Do you want to take it with you?
column2: 抽屉里放着一颗暗红宝石。你要把它带走吗？

column1: A pile of ash sits inside the fireplace.
column2: 壁炉里有一堆灰。

column1: A stifling, oppressive air begins to invade your senses as you look upward.
column2: 你抬头望去，一股令人窒息的压抑空气开始侵入你的感官。

column1: As you reach the top of the stairs, your head and chest begin to feel heavy and thick. The room lurches.
column2: 你走到楼梯顶端时，头和胸口开始发沉、发闷。房间猛地一晃。

column1: As you reach the top of the stairs, your head and chest begin to feel heavy and thick. You take a moment to regain your balance.
column2: 你走到楼梯顶端时，头和胸口开始发沉、发闷。你停了一会儿，才重新站稳。

column1: At the bottom, you can see a room which is considerably larger than the circumference of the well.
column2: 在底部，你能看见一间比这口井的周长要大得多的房间。

column1: Climb back up?
column2: 爬回去？

column1: Climb down?
column2: 爬下去？

column1: Head upstairs?
column2: 上楼去？

column1: Head upstaris?
column2: 上楼去？

column1: It looks like a bit of a squeeze, but it should now be safe to enter the well.
column2: 看起来有点挤，不过现在进井应该安全了。

column1: It would be possible to climb into the well safely with the rope. Would you like to use it?
column2: 有这根绳子，就能安全地爬进井里。你要用它吗？

column1: It's quite a long drop. You might be able to make it safely if you had a rope.
column2: 落差相当大。你要是有根绳子，也许能安全下去。

column1: Most of the food here is either stale or mouldy. You comb over the table and pick out some of the least non-edible morsels.
column2: 这里的食物大多要么不新鲜，要么发了霉。你把桌子翻了一遍，挑出一些最不至于不能吃的碎食。

column1: Now that you're looking for it, you manage to find a length of rope that still seems tough enough to use for climbing.
column2: 既然你在找，你还是找到了一截看起来仍够结实、可以用来攀爬的绳子。

column1: Read the next entry?
column2: 读下一条？

column1: Show the Serenity Gem to the skeleton?
column2: 把宁静宝石给骷髅看？

column1: Take the gem with you?
column2: 把宝石带走？

column1: The cabinet is filled with neatly folded napkins and assorted cutlery.
column2: 柜子里装满叠得整齐的餐巾和各式餐具。

column1: The door slams shut behind you. Welcome home.
column2: 门在你身后砰地关上。欢迎回家。

column1: The gem you retrieved from the well is reacting strongly to the skeleton. It is pulsing with light and energy.
column2: 你从井里取出的宝石正对这具骷髅起强烈反应。它正以光与能量脉动。

column1: The journey back up is significantly harder than it was going down...
column2: 往回爬比下去时难得多……

column1: The memories of a thousand loaves of freshly baked bread are deeply ingrained in these bricks.
column2: 一千条新鲜出炉的面包的记忆，深深烙在这些砖里。

column1: The mysterious forces inside the estate will not allow you to leave.
column2: 庄园里的神秘力量不会允许你离开。

column1: The oppressive air inside this room begins to seep into your subconscious. You don't know how much longer you can take it.
column2: 这房间里压抑的空气开始渗进你的潜意识。你不知道自己还能承受多久。

column1: The remaining pages are blank.
column2: 剩下的书页是空白的。

column1: The resistance suddenly gives way. The handle jolts upwards and sets into place.
column2: 阻力突然消失。把手猛地向上一弹，卡进了位置。

column1: The rope dangles from above, about a foot from the floor.
column2: 绳子从上方垂下来，末端离地大约一英尺。

column1: The skeleton begins to writhe. A wicked force knocks the gem out of your hand.
column2: 骷髅开始扭动。一股邪恶的力量把宝石从你手里打落。

column1: The trough is empty. The wooden boards that formed the bottom are now parted, and you can see down into the well.
column2: 水槽是空的。构成槽底的木板现在分开了，你能看见下面的井。

column1: The water pump is weathered and rusty, but still looks useable. Do you want to give it a try?
column2: 水泵风吹雨打，生了锈，可看起来还能用。你要试试吗？

column1: There is a blackened, iron key hidden underneath the mattress. The tag around the handle has the word "Cellar" written on it.
column2: 床垫底下藏着一把发黑的铁钥匙。柄上的标签写着“地窖”。

column1: There is a leather bound diary on this desk. Would you like to read it?
column2: 这张书桌上有一本皮面日记。你要读吗？

column1: There is a little key on the table. The tag attached to the handle has the word "Pantry" written on it.
column2: 桌子上有一把小钥匙。系在柄上的标签写着“食品间”。

column1: There is a small splash from the previously drained water as you land. The air down here is cool and dry.
column2: 你落地时，先前排掉的水溅起一小片水花。下面的空气又凉又干。

column1: There is a stack of papers on the table. All of them have lists and arrangements for a "Summer Festival".
column2: 桌子上有一叠纸。全都是一场“夏日节”的清单和安排。

column1: This bed is undressed, but still looks very comfortable.
column2: 这张床没有铺被褥，可看起来仍很舒服。

column1: This box is packed with camping and hiking equipment.
column2: 这只箱子里塞满了露营和徒步的装备。

column1: This trough is filled with stale water. It looks remarkably like a well.
column2: 这水槽里盛着陈水。它看起来非常像一口井。

column1: Would you like to take the rope?
column2: 你要把绳子拿走吗？

column1: You attempt to light the lantern, but nothing happens.
column2: 你试图点燃灯笼，可什么也没发生。

column1: You attempt to light the lantern, but your arms suddenly feel as if they are made of lead.
column2: 你试图点燃灯笼，可双臂突然像是铅做的。

column1: You begin to work the pump. Raising the handle is proving more difficult than expected.
column2: 你开始压水泵。把把手抬起来比预想的更难。

column1: You can feel the souls that linger on the estate gather before you.
column2: 你能感到徘徊在庄园里的灵魂在你面前聚拢。

column1: You can see the back garden from here.
column2: 你从这里能看见后花园。

column1: You can see the back garden from here. A chilly breeze brushes against you.
column2: 你从这里能看见后花园。一阵凉风拂过你。

column1: You fasten one end of the rope around the base of the water pump. After checking to see if it is secure, you drop the other end into the well.
column2: 你把绳子的一端系在水泵底座上。确认系牢之后，你把另一端丢进井里。

column1: You feel the oppressive air inside this room trying to seep into your subconscious.
column2: 你感到这房间里压抑的空气正试图渗进你的潜意识。

column1: You notice the bottom of the trough is lined with wooden boards, and they appear to be slightly below ground level.
column2: 你注意到水槽底部铺着木板，而且它们似乎略低于地面。

column1: You peek inside and see a large, glowing gem resting on a cushion. Looking at the gem makes you feel rested and at ease.
column2: 你往里一瞧，看见一颗巨大的发光宝石搁在垫子上。看着这颗宝石，你感到歇息下来，也安然。

column1: You take a hold of the rope and carefully climb down into the well.
column2: 你抓住绳子，小心地爬下井去。

column1: You take the gem and hold it out. The skeleton is bathed in its light.
column2: 你拿起宝石，伸到前面。骷髅沐浴在它的光里。

column1: Are you also fond of wall-of-meat" barbarian types? I could tell. You must ensure that no matter what happens, that orc is never, ever allowed to wear a shirt. Write it into law if you must. Ensure that this one survives, will you? I couldn't bear to see him damaged."
column2: “你也喜欢那种“肉墙”式的野蛮人吗？我看得出来。你必须确保，无论发生什么，那名兽人永远、永远不许穿衬衫。必要的话就写进法律。确保这一个能活下来，好吗？我可受不了看见他被弄坏。”

column1: Barrod cradles Leviathan's head in his arms, whispering softly to him and stroking his beard, like a parent consoling a wounded child. Barrod catches your gaze, and gives you a silent, appreciative nod.
column2: Barrod 把 Leviathan 的头抱在臂弯里，轻声对他低语，抚摸他的胡子，像父母安慰受伤的孩子。Barrod 迎上你的目光，无声地对你点了点头，表示感激。

column1: Barrod disappears, and Leviathan stirs, finally speaking with a voice as deep and profound as the sea.
column2: Barrod 消失了，Leviathan 动了动，终于开口，声音深沉悠远，一如大海。

column1: Beauregard balls his fists and grinds his teeth in anger for a long moment.
column2: Beauregard 愤怒地握紧双拳，咬了好一会儿牙。

column1: Even so, these pages are badly damaged. They are legible, but they crumble as you turn them. You can only read this once.
column2: 即便如此，这些书页也损坏得很厉害。它们还能读，可你一翻就碎。你只能读这一次。

column1: It looks as though this wall panel is fit improperly. You might be able to move it with enough brute strength.
column2: 这块墙板看起来装得不严实。蛮力够大的话，你也许挪得动它。

column1: It's heavier than it seems. You might want to catch your breath and try again.
column2: 它比看上去重。你也许该喘口气，再试一次。

column1: Leviathan bows his head to you and then slips beneath the water and out of sight. It is finally over.
column2: Leviathan 向你低下头，随后滑入水下，消失不见。终于结束了。

column1: Lighting the incense will heal one person fully, but you will not be able to use it more than once.
column2: 点燃香会让一个人完全痊愈，但你只能使用一次。

column1: Out of the brine rises the head and torso of Leviathan, at once bursting with power and helplessly restrained. His eyes, perhaps once intelligent, are glazed with impotent rage.
column2: 卤水中升起 Leviathan 的头与躯干，既迸发着力量，又无助地被束缚着。他的眼睛或许曾经聪慧，此刻却蒙着一层无力的狂怒。

column1: The doors close behind you as you step into the opulent structure. There is no going back now.
column2: 你步入这座奢华的建筑时，门在身后关上。现在已经无法回头。

column1: The final anchor snaps, and Leviathan pauses in his assault, his body visibly relaxing.
column2: 最后一处锚点崩断，Leviathan 停住攻击，身体明显松了下来。

column1: There is a sigil on the floor, lit in glittering silver dust and ringed with unburnt cones of incense. When you step inside, an aura of serene calm washes over you.
column2: 地板上有一枚符印，以闪烁的银粉点亮，周围环着未点燃的香锥。你踏进去时，一阵宁静安然的气息漫过你。

column1: This corpse has been here long enough that it's hardened and turned black. Strangely, the moisture hasn't destroyed it.
column2: 这具尸体在这儿待得够久，已经硬化发黑。奇怪的是，湿气并没有毁掉它。

column1: This is written in a large, unsteady hand, across many pages. Whoever did this wanted to ensure that his writing survived the passage of time.
column2: 这是用很大、不稳的字迹写下的，横跨许多页。写的人想确保自己的字能熬过时间。

column1: With a final, decisive strike, Leviathan's body goes limp, and he slips down into the pool, clouds of his divine blood murking the water. The battle is over.
column2: 随着最后决定性的一击，Leviathan 的身体瘫软，滑入池中，一团团神血把水搅浑。战斗结束了。

column1: With a mighty heave, you force the panel aside, revealing a rough-hewn passageway.
column2: 你猛地一掀，把墙板推到一旁，露出一条粗凿的通道。

column1: It appears that the way forward is now open.
column2: 看来向前的路现在已经打开。

column1: The path to the exit is now clear.
column2: 通往出口的路现在已经畅通。

column1: This bow is crafted from the same strange material as the rest of this place, and touching the string runs a shiver down your spine.
column2: 这把弓与此地其余物事用同一种奇异材料制成，一碰弓弦，战栗便顺着脊背窜下。

column1: This chest is thrumming with power, and your fingertips tingle when you touch the lid. Will you open it?
column2: 这只箱子正随着力量嗡鸣，你一碰箱盖，指尖便发麻。要打开它吗？

column1: You decide to wait a moment before opening the chest.
column2: 你决定先等一会儿，再打开箱子。

column1: A small crate has been left behind here. It's mostly full of rags, but at the bottom, you find what appears to be a potion.
column2: 这里留下一只小板条箱。里面大半是破布，可在底部，你找到了一样像是药水的东西。

column1: Cut yourself on the blade?
column2: 用刀刃割伤自己？

column1: The barricade doesn't move, but you could always try it again.
column2: 路障没有动，不过你随时可以再试。

column1: There is a small blade mounted at the top of this statue, with an inscription that reads, "Blood for Power".
column2: 这座雕像顶端装着一小片刀刃，铭文写着：“以血换力量”。

column1: This barricade seems fairly sturdy, but someone with a strong back might be able to tear it down.
column2: 这道路障看起来相当结实，不过腰板够硬的人也许能把它拆掉。

column1: You heave the beams out of place and the barricade topples down.
column2: 你把梁木掀开，路障倒塌下来。

column1: There is a note on the table here. It appears to show a list of a merchant's expenses and profits. There is a very colorfully-worded complaint about a 10,000$ expense listed at the bottom.
column2: 这里的桌子上有一张条子。看起来是一名商人的开支与利润清单。底部列着一笔10,000$的开支，旁边是一句措辞极其花哨的抱怨。

column1: Everyone appears to be well-rested, and Vankan seems to be in a particularly good mood. Last night's conversation was probably a load off of his mind.
column2: 大家看起来都休息得很好，Vankan 似乎心情特别好。昨夜的谈话大概让他心里卸下了一块石头。

column1: Everyone appears to have rested well.
column2: 大家看起来都休息得很好。

column1: Grinning, you tiptoe toward the door, careful not to wake your other companions.
column2: 你咧着嘴，踮着脚尖走向门口，小心不把其他同伴吵醒。

column1: In the morning, it appears that your party has rested well.
column2: 到了早晨，你的队伍看起来休息得很好。

column1: It is clear that he has next to no experience in this, but his fondness for you shines through, and he follows your example.
column2: 显然他在这方面几乎毫无经验，可他对你的喜爱溢于言表，并照着你的样子做。

column1: Looking around, it appears that Vankan has gone missing. His clothes are still on the floor beside his bed. Could he have written the note?
column2: 你四下看了看，Vankan 似乎不见了。他的衣服还在床边的地板上。那张条子会是他写的吗？

column1: The beds are more or less clean, and the place even has a modest stock of preserves, so for once your evening is relaxed and easy.
column2: 床铺大体还算干净，这地方甚至还备着一点不多的腌食，所以这一晚难得轻松自在。

column1: Vankan is extremely awkward, but he gradually relaxes and begins to enjoy himself as you partake of each others' bodies in the warm evening air.
column2: Vankan 别扭极了，可他渐渐放松，开始享受起来，你们在温暖的夜风里享用彼此的身体。

column1: Vankan probably just went to relieve himself. The note may have been referring to waking in the morning anyway. You decide to go back to sleep.
column2: Vankan 大概只是去解手了。那张条子说的也许本来就是早晨醒来的事。你决定回去睡觉。

column1: Vankan smiles and bows his head a little when you catch his eye. It seems he's in a good mood.
column2: 你与他目光相接时，Vankan 笑了笑，微微低下头。看来他心情不错。

column1: When you've both finished, you return to the rest stop together and crawl back into your beds, drifting off with little trouble.
column2: 你们两个都结束后，一起回到歇脚站，爬回各自的床上，没费什么事就睡着了。

column1: You and your party make yourselves at home in the rest stop, reassured by Vankan's predictions.
column2: 你和你的队伍在歇脚站安顿下来，Vankan 的预言让人安心。

column1: You fall asleep readily, but you wake up in the middle of the night, suddenly aware of an object in your hand. It appears to be a crumpled wad of paper.
column2: 你很快睡着了，可半夜醒过来，突然发觉手里有个东西。看起来是一团皱巴巴的纸。

column1: You get back to sleep with little difficulty, and the night passes without further incident.
column2: 你没费什么事就又睡着了，这一夜再没出事。

column1: You make long eye contact with Vankan a few times, but he seems confused.
column2: 你有几次与 Vankan 对视了很久，可他似乎一脸茫然。

column1: You rub the sleep out of your eyes and stumble out of bed, finding a spot with enough moonlight streaming in to read by.
column2: 你揉掉眼里的睡意，跌跌撞撞下了床，找了一处月光够亮、能借着读字的地方。

column1: You thought to show him the note so you could ask him about it, but it isn't anywhere to be found. Perhaps you dreamt the whole thing after all.
column2: 你本想把条子给他看，好问问他，可哪儿都找不着。也许你终究是把整件事梦出来的。

column1: A sensation of panic crawls up your spine. The force that holds this place in perfect stillness is beginning to slip away, and something desperate is taking its place.
column2: 一阵恐慌顺着脊背爬上来。维持此地完美静止的那股力量开始消散，某种绝望的东西正取而代之。

column1: Glamig's crown begins to emit a low harmonic tone. It is resonating with something here.
column2: Glamig 的王冠开始发出低沉的和声。它正与这里的某样东西共鸣。

column1: Powerful magic pulses through this crystal. It appears to be the source of the strange aura that pervades this place.
column2: 强大的魔力在这块水晶中脉动。它似乎就是弥漫此地的那股奇异灵气的源头。

column1: The Orc reels for a moment, barely able to stand as a wave of dizziness overcomes him.
column2: 那名兽人晃了一下，一阵眩晕袭来，他几乎站不稳。

column1: The air goes cold, and a voice like cracking ice tears through it like a shiver.
column2: 空气变冷，一个像冰层碎裂的声音如战栗般撕开空气。

column1: The crystal shatters as the energies that fuel it destabilize and disperse.
column2: 供养水晶的能量失稳散去，水晶随之碎裂。

column1: The lid of this chest refuses to budge even a little, as though some tremendous force is holding it shut.
column2: 这只箱子的盖子丝毫不动，仿佛有某种巨大的力量把它死死压住。

column1: This orc stands motionless in the light of the thrumming crystal. He is not breathing, but otherwise appears to be alive.
column2: 这名兽人在嗡鸣水晶的光里一动不动地站着。他没有呼吸，除此之外却像是活着。

column1: Try as you might, you cannot light this brazier. It is as if the oil is refusing the acknowledge the spark.
column2: 你怎么试都点不着这只火盆。仿佛油拒绝承认那点火星。

column1: You relay what little information you were given by Queen Glamig, and his face goes somber.
column2: 你转述了女王 Glamig 告诉你的那一点点信息，他的脸色沉了下来。

column1: ...but it don't feel like that at all, and I can't stop thinkin' about him. I think I might actually be glad to be here.
column2: ……可完全不是那种感觉，我还停不下来地想他。我觉得自己也许其实乐意待在这儿。

column1: ...come by again. I guess this might become a thing. I thought it would feel weirder, like I'd done something awful, like I'd want to barf and off myself...
column2: ……再来一回。我猜这事也许会成了常态。我本以为感觉会更怪，像是我干了什么可怕的事，像是我想吐，还想把自己弄死……

column1: ...it's been six years since I've been shipped out and I ain't so much as caught sight of a woman. Plus, the foreman's been real good to me and the others.
column2: ……我被送出来已经六年了，连个女人的影都没见着。再说，工头对我和对其他人都真挺好。

column1: And here, this is the key he mentioned. I still have my copy. Maybe it'll come in handy.
column2: 还有，这就是他提到的那把钥匙。我自己那把还在。也许用得上。

column1: Anyway, thanks. I'm going to see if there's any food or water to be snatched up and then be off. I'll leave the valuables for you.
column2: 总之，谢了。我去看看能不能捞到点吃的喝的，然后就走。贵重的东西留给你。

column1: Giving it a thorough check, you find a key hidden under one of the edges.
column2: 你仔细检查了一番，发现一把钥匙藏在其中一条边的下面。

column1: Hopelessly curious, you turn the page and keep reading.
column2: 你好奇得停不下来，翻过这一页，继续读。

column1: I had to pretend I was sick today so the others wouldn't ask why I can barely walk. Holy shit I needed that. I think I still need it. He let me keep the key so I can...
column2: 我今天只好装病，免得别人问我为什么几乎走不了路。我操，我真需要那一下。我觉得我还需要。他把钥匙留给我，好让我能……

column1: I hope you don't mind, but I'm going to keep this diary. Please, it would mean a lot to me.
column2: 希望你不介意，这本日记我要留下。求你了，这对我很重要。

column1: It looks like the entry keeps going.
column2: 这条记录似乎还没完。

column1: It looks like there are no more loose items in the pages.
column2: 书页里似乎不再夹着松脱的东西了。

column1: Krade... I never knew you kept a diary.
column2: Krade……我从不知道你写日记。

column1: The foreman gave me the key to his cabin so I can come by quietly after dark. I've never been with an orc before, or a man either for that matter, but...
column2: 工头把他小屋的钥匙给了我，好让我天黑后悄悄过去。我以前从没跟兽人上过床，跟男人倒也没有，可是……

column1: The ground near this rock is scraped, as though it's been moved recently.
column2: 这块岩石附近的地面有刮痕，像是最近被挪动过。

column1: There is a diary on this night table. It appears to be somewhat lurid.
column2: 这张床头柜上有一本日记。内容看起来有些露骨。

column1: They caught me sneakin' around. Figured you'd have to be a complete moron to get caught by a bunch of ogres. Guess that makes me the moron, huh?
column2: 他们抓到我在偷偷转悠。本以为得是个彻头彻尾的傻逼，才会被一帮食人魔抓住。看来傻逼就是我了，是吧？

column1: This chest is rusted shut, and no key in the world is going to open it. Would you like to try forcing it?
column2: 这只箱子锈死了，世上没有任何钥匙开得了它。你要试试硬撬开吗？

column1: Well, that sounded messy. Good to see that it's old gorgeous on the floor instead of you.
column2: 呵，听着挺狼藉。幸好倒在地上的是那位老美人，而不是你。

column1: You leave the chest alone for now.
column2: 你暂时不去动这只箱子。

column1: You pick an entry toward the end and start reading.
column2: 你挑了靠近末尾的一条，开始读。

column1: You shake the diary and a key falls out.
column2: 你抖了抖日记，一把钥匙掉了出来。

column1: You turn the page, only to find it blank. You put the book back.
column2: 你翻过一页，却发现是空白。你把书放了回去。

column1: You've read quite enough. You put the book back where you found it.
column2: 你已经读得够多了。你把书放回原处。

column1: A dryad is rooted here in front of the door. She appears to be weeping.
column2: 一名树精在门前扎根而立。她似乎在哭泣。

column1: A kindly woman's voice echoes through the room.
column2: 一个和善的女人声音在房间里回荡。

column1: A stern man's voice echoes through the room.
column2: 一个严厉的男人声音在房间里回荡。

column1: She said "Only the stone survives." \n\nShow her the Mountain Soul?
column2: 她说“唯有石头留存。”\n\n把山岳之魂给她看？

column1: The condition of the nearby bones suggests that this person was taken down violently from behind, perhaps by one of the creatures you've fought.
column2: 附近骸骨的状况表明，这个人是从背后被猛烈击倒的，也许是你交过手的那些生物之一干的。

column1: There is a dreadful miasma rising up out of the stairwell. Whatever has corrupted the temple lies below.
column2: 一股可怕的瘴气从楼梯井里升上来。腐化了这座神殿的东西，就在下面。

column1: This chest appears to have been broken into already. It looks as though whoever it was hastily stashed some things inside.
column2: 这只箱子看来已经被撬开过。看上去不管是谁，都匆忙往里面塞了些东西。

column1: This wall appears to be very weak. If you had a pickaxe, you could probably break through it.
column2: 这面墙看起来非常不结实。你要是有一把镐，大概能把它凿穿。

column1: This wall is in very poor condition. You might be able to get through it with your pickaxe.
column2: 这面墙状况非常差。你也许能用你的镐凿过去。

column1: You show the Dryad the Mountain Soul.
column2: 你把山岳之魂给树精看。

column1: Something doesn't seem right.
column2: 有什么地方不太对劲。

column1: This ominous chest is securely locked. Perhaps the key is somewhere in the rubble.
column2: 这只不祥的箱子锁得死死的。也许钥匙就在瓦砾的什么地方。

column1: This pile of rubble is still smouldering. Search through it?
column2: 这堆瓦砾还在闷烧。要翻一翻吗？

column1: A strange vibration ripples through the air as you touch the gate.
column2: 你触到大门时，一阵奇怪的震动在空气中荡开。

column1: Now that you have a moment to examine the gate latch, you can see that it's only tied shut with a heavy rope. It takes you a moment, but you are able to undo the knot, and the gate falls open.
column2: 现在你有空检查门闩，能看见它只是用一根粗绳系死的。你花了一点时间，但还是解开了绳结，门便敞了开来。

column1: The enchantment is stronger than you expected. You'll need to try again more carefully.
column2: 这附魔比你预料的更强。你得更小心地再试一次。

column1: There are still several useful items on his body. He certainly won't be needing them.
column2: 他身上还有好几件有用的东西。他肯定用不上了。

column1: This body is crumpled and withered, seemingly by unnatural means. Who knows what these witches have done to him?
column2: 这具尸体皱缩枯萎，似乎是被不自然的手段弄成这样的。谁知道这些女巫对他做了什么？

column1: This crystal appears to be an anchor for an enchantment. Someone of sufficient skill could unravel it.
column2: 这块水晶似乎是一则附魔的锚点。技艺够高的人可以把它拆解。

column1: Skyway closed for maintenance
column2: 天路因检修关闭

column1: Chuckling to himself, Paul casually puts his axe down, kicks his boots off, undoes his belts, and drops his clothes to the floor, stepping out of them with proud ease.
column2: Paul 自己轻笑着，随手放下斧头，踢掉靴子，解开腰带，把衣服丢到地上，带着骄傲的从容从里面迈出来。

column1: Eventually, you roll out your bedrolls on the raised frames and settle in for a restful night.
column2: 末了，你们在垫高的床架上铺开铺盖卷，安顿下来，准备过一个能好好休息的夜晚。

column1: Everyone seems to have slept well. Paul and Peregrine seem to be in particularly high spirits.
column2: 大家似乎都睡得很好。Paul 和 Peregrine 看起来兴致尤其高。

column1: Peregrine looks on slackjawed as Paul poses for him shamelessly.
column2: Peregrine 看得合不拢嘴，Paul 则不知羞耻地对着他摆姿势。

column1: Peregrine seems especially happy to share the moment with everyone.
column2: Peregrine 似乎特别高兴能和大家分享这一刻。

column1: The better part of the evening is spent sitting with your friends in the small bath chamber, chatting and washing the marks of the long road off of each others' skin.
column2: 晚上的大部分时间，你都和朋友们坐在狭小的浴室里，聊天，把长路留在彼此皮肤上的痕迹洗掉。

column1: The shelter is a little musty, but it is dry and well-protected. You lay your bedrolls out on the wooden frames, and the night passes without further incident.
column2: 这处庇护所有点发霉，但干燥，防护也很好。你们把铺盖卷铺在木架上，一夜再无意外。

column1: As you pull together the threads of mana, something seems to be out of place. You realize at the last moment that the spell is a trap, and you are blasted with a wave of violent energy.
column2: 你把法力的丝线聚拢时，似乎有什么不对劲。你在最后一刻意识到这法术是个陷阱，一波狂暴的能量将你轰击。

column1: Some runes have been etched into the wall. It appears to be an incomplete spell, commonly used in magically-sealed passageways. A competent weaver should be able to open the passage.
column2: 墙上蚀刻着一些符文。这似乎是一则未完成的法术，常用于以魔力封印的通道。一个称职的编织者应当能够打开这条通道。

column1: The decoy runes vanish, leaving no trace of your folly but for the throbbing in your arm.
column2: 诱饵符文消失了，除了你手臂里的抽痛，这次愚蠢再无痕迹。

column1: The drapery on this sculpture is masterfully crafted. Clearly the work of a skilled artisan.
column2: 这尊雕塑上的衣褶工艺精湛。显然是熟练匠人的手笔。

column1: The handiwork on this sculpture is so fine that there are no tooling marks showing.
column2: 这尊雕塑的手工精细得看不见任何工具痕迹。

column1: The magical runes crackle and dissipate. Whatever may have been concealed here is forever beyond your reach.
column2: 魔力符文噼啪作响，随即消散。这里也许曾经藏着的东西，永远到不了你手里。

column1: The proportions of the woman depicted in this sculpture are sublime.
column2: 这尊雕塑中女子的比例美妙绝伦。

column1: This statue is intricately carved, the marble clothing looks almost translucent over the female form.
column2: 这尊雕像雕刻精细，大理石衣物覆在女性形体上，看上去几乎透明。

column1: You fumble through the spell and the magic fizzles. You should probably be able to attempt it again, however.
column2: 你施展法术时失手，魔力熄灭了。不过，你大概还能再试一次。

column1: You weave the threads of mana together into perfect formation, and the spell is complete. The wall vanishes into thin air, revealing a vault carved in alabaster marble. It appears to have lain undisturbed for ages.
column2: 你把法力的丝线编织成完美的形态，法术完成了。墙壁凭空消失，露出一座以雪花石膏大理石凿成的宝库。它看上去已经不知多少年代无人打扰。

column1: Inside this chest is a magnificent whip, throbbing with uneasy energy.
column2: 这只箱子里有一条华丽的鞭子，搏动着不安的能量。

column1: As you approach, the lips on the statue begin to move, and it whispers to you in a grainy voice.
column2: 你走近时，雕像的嘴唇开始动了，它用沙砾般的声音对你低语。

column1: Feed 12000$ to the statue?
column2: 把12000$喂给雕像？

column1: It takes nearly two hours to feed all of the money in through the mouth of the statue, but as you do, bit by bit, golden stairs appear before you, bridging the chasm cleanly.
column2: 你花了将近两个小时，才把所有的钱从雕像嘴里喂进去，可就在你一点一点喂的时候，金色的阶梯出现在你面前，干净利落地跨过了裂隙。

column1: The statue appears to be broken.
column2: 雕像看起来是坏的。

column1: The statue's mouth yawns open.
column2: 雕像的嘴张得老大。

column1: The smell is reminiscent of the fluid you found when you started exploring Chrun.
column2: 这气味让你想起刚开始探索克伦时发现的那种液体。

column1: A light shock shivers through your body. Touching the fluid must have somehow connected you with the nerves of this place for a split second, almost as if the walls were part of your own body.
column2: 一阵轻微的电击颤过你的身体。触碰那液体一定在某一瞬间把你和这地方的神经连在了一起，几乎像那些墙就是你自己身体的一部分。

column1: A thick rope of nervous tissue is stretched between the floor and the ceiling.
column2: 一束粗如绳索的神经组织绷在地板和天花板之间。

column1: He surely won't be needing his supplies any longer.
column2: 他的补给肯定再也不需要了。

column1: Seems whoever this was got walled in and couldn't escape.
column2: 看来不管这人是谁，都被封进了墙里，逃不出去。

column1: There is a churning pool of thick, foul fluid here. It seems fresher here than at the nerve bundles.
column2: 这里有一池翻搅着的浓稠恶臭液体。它在这里似乎比在神经束那里更新鲜。

column1: You dunk a bottle into the fluid and collect some of it.
column2: 你把一只瓶子浸进液体里，收集了一些。

column1: You felt the ground and walls shudder, but there is no obvious change.
column2: 你感觉到地面和墙壁在震颤，但没有明显的变化。

column1: An impressive statue of a man. While it is only roughly carved, all the features of the body are clearly defined.
column2: 一尊引人注目的男人雕像。雕工虽然粗糙，身体的每一处特征却都清晰可辨。

column1: On the other side of the wall you can hear some movement. The wall here is still quite solid, but appears cracked enough that a strong physical or magical blow could break through. Attempt using your strength or magical prowess?
column2: 你能听见墙的另一边有些动静。这里的墙仍然相当结实，但裂得够开，一记强劲的物理或魔力打击也许能打穿。要动用你的力量或魔力本事试一试吗？

column1: The contents of the chest have all been taken, likely by that annoying goblin.
column2: 箱子里的东西全被拿走了，多半是那个讨厌的哥布林干的。

column1: There is nothing left to be found within this chest.
column2: 这只箱子里已经没什么可找的了。

column1: Upon further inspection, you find a button on the pillar of the statue underneath the arm of the man. When you press it, you hear a loud rumbling noise as the wall nearby opens up.
column2: 你再仔细查看，发现雕像柱子上、男人手臂下方有一个按钮。你按下它，听见附近的墙发出响亮的隆隆声，随即打开。

column1: You find... nothing.
column2: 你找到了……什么也没有。

column1: You manage to force through the wall, and when the dust settles, you find that it leads to the tomb where the goblin disappeared.
column2: 你设法强行打穿墙壁，尘土落下后，发现它通向哥布林消失的那座墓。

column1: You manage to force through the wall, to reveal a hidden tomb. In addition, you end up surprising the goblin who was still trying to place the contents of the chests into his sack.
column2: 你设法强行打穿墙壁，露出一座隐藏的墓。此外，你还吓到了那个哥布林，他正把箱子里的东西往袋子里装。

column1: You peer into the chest, and possibly due to the surprise of you breaking down the tomb wall, the goblin had missed an emerald.
column2: 你往箱子里看去。也许是你砸开墓墙吓了哥布林一跳，他漏掉了一颗祖母绿。

column1: A few spare coins remain in this cabinet.
column2: 这个柜子里还剩几枚零星的硬币。

column1: There are several ancient, rusted tools in this cabinet, probably used for woodworking.
column2: 这个柜子里有几件古老的生锈工具，大概是用来做木工的。

column1: This heavily-eroded statue depicts the body of an idealized man. Its details have been smoothed away over time, but a name can still be read along the base.
column2: 这尊严重侵蚀的雕像刻画的是一个理想化的男人身体。细节已被时间磨平，但底座上仍能读出一个名字。

column1: This signpost is faded too badly to be legible, but it seems to be indicating that this building is a shop.
column2: 这块路牌褪色得太厉害，已经无法辨认，但似乎在表明这栋建筑是一家店铺。

column1: A bit of glinting metal catches your eye amid the mushrooms in this patch.
column2: 这片蘑菇丛里，一点闪光的金属映入你的眼。

column1: A mouth-watering aroma sends your head into a spin when you approach this patch of mushrooms. Sitting amid less remarkable varieties is a white truffle, widely renowned for its delicate texture and intoxicating flavor.
column2: 你走近这片蘑菇时，一股令人垂涎的香气冲得你头晕目眩。不太起眼的品种之间，坐着一枚白松露，它以细腻的质地和醉人的风味广负盛名。

column1: Amid the mushrooms in this patch, you find a variety that is edible, if not delicious.
column2: 你在这片蘑菇里找到一种能吃的品种，虽说算不上美味。

column1: Approaching this mushroom patch apparently upsets the creatures milling about. They all turn toward you and attack.
column2: 靠近这片蘑菇显然惊扰了四处乱转的生物。它们全都转向你，发动攻击。

column1: Approaching this mushroom patch apparently upsets the large mushroom creature nearby. It and its kin all turn toward you and attack.
column2: 靠近这片蘑菇显然惊扰了附近那只巨大的蘑菇生物。它和它的同类全都转向你，发动攻击。

column1: As you approach the sack, something rushes at you from behind!
column2: 你靠近袋子时，有东西从背后向你冲来！

column1: As you poke around this mushroom patch, something quivers and lurches up out of the ground toward you!
column2: 你在这片蘑菇丛里戳弄时，有什么东西颤动起来，从地里猛地朝你扑上来！

column1: From atop this pillar, you could probably climb to the ledge above, however, it does not look sturdy, and it would not be an easy climb.
column2: 从这根柱子顶上，你大概能爬到上方的岩架，不过它看起来并不结实，爬起来也不会轻松。

column1: He pauses a moment, sniffing the air conspicuously. It seems you're carrying something that he is especially interested in - probably the rare white truffle you have in your pockets.
column2: 他停了一停，大张旗鼓地嗅着空气。看来你身上带着他特别感兴趣的东西——大概是你口袋里那枚稀有的白松露。

column1: No sooner does the last person arrive however, than you spot a groggy giant scrambling for his weapon. It seems you've interrupted someone's nap.
column2: 然而最后一个人刚到，你就看见一个睡眼惺忪的巨人正手忙脚乱去抓武器。看来你打断了谁的午睡。

column1: Picking up the sack, you discover another climbing chain hidden under it. In the sack itself is a handful of coins, but nothing else of note.
column2: 提起袋子，你发现下面还藏着另一条攀爬锁链。袋子里有一把硬币，此外没有什么值得注意的。

column1: Seeing your reflection in the crystal clear water, you can see that the last few battles have left you rather filthy. The fountain is practically inviting you to wash your face.
column2: 看见自己映在清澈见底的水中，你能看出前几场战斗把你弄得相当肮脏。这眼泉水简直在邀请你洗把脸。

column1: The giant's lone eye narrows as you back away. He charges, apparently deciding to take what he wants off of your corpse.
column2: 你后退时，巨人那只独眼眯了起来。他冲上来，显然决定从你的尸体上拿走他想要的东西。

column1: The pillar is more fragile than you expected, and crumbles out from beneath your feet before you have a chance to reach the upper ledge.
column2: 这根柱子比你预料的更脆，你还没来得及够到上层岩架，它就从你脚下崩塌了。

column1: The pillar is practically disintegrating beneath your feet, but you manage to use what's left of it to climb up, and you take a moment to help your party follow.
column2: 柱子几乎在你脚下解体，但你还是借着剩下的部分爬了上去，并花了一点时间帮你的队伍跟上。

column1: There is a broken column of stone here, and it is irregular enough to make for easy climbing to the ledge above.
column2: 这里有一根断裂的石柱，形状不规则，正好方便爬到上方的岩架。

column1: There is a chain anchored to the cliff here. You could use it to easily drop to the ledge below.
column2: 这里有一条锁链固定在悬崖上。你可以借它轻松降到下方的岩架。

column1: This rock is firmly anchored. If you had a rope, you could climb to the lower ledge from here.
column2: 这块岩石固定得很牢。你要是有绳子，就能从这里爬到下层岩架。

column1: This rock is firmly anchored. If you lower your rope, you could easily climb down to the ledge below.
column2: 这块岩石固定得很牢。你要是放下绳子，就能轻松爬到下方的岩架。

column1: When you reach the lower ledge, you see a number of mushrooms with faces waddling around. They have seen you, but do not seem to be particularly concerned.
column2: 到达下层岩架时，你看见好些长着脸的蘑菇正摇摇摆摆地走来走去。它们看见了你，却似乎并不怎么在意。

column2: 你把白松露递给巨人，他从你手里一把夺过，吵闹地狼吞虎咽下去。一阵醇和的欣快漫过他的脸——眼下他不是威胁。

column1: You light the signal fire to indicate to the rest of your band that this area has been secured.
column2: 你点燃信号火，好让你的团伙其余的人知道这一带已经肃清。

column1: You poke around the mushroom patch, but don't find anything edible.
column2: 你在蘑菇丛里戳了戳，没找到任何能吃的东西。

column1: You've caught him in a foul mood, it seems. He charges straight at you.
column2: 看来你碰上他心情很糟的时候。他径直向你冲来。

column1: It reads : This is a holy sanctuary. Entry is prohibited to all but our brothers.
column2: 上面写着：此处为神圣庇护所。除我等弟兄外，禁止进入。

column2: 你想起自己带着的那块熔渣。要把圣骑士之魂放上基座吗？

column2: 这基座结着片片剥落的锈。最顶端有一段铭文。

column1: You decide to hold on to the Paladin Soul for now. Perhaps it can be of use elsewhere.
column2: 你决定暂时留着圣骑士之魂。也许它在别处用得上。

column1: Do you have any idea what the word Portas" means? A madman came through here a while ago, and it was carved into his skin in several places. He was too crazed to answer me when I asked, but I can't stop thinking about it."
column2: “你知道‘Portas’这个词是什么意思吗？不久前有个疯子从这儿经过，这个词被刻在他皮肤上好几处。我问他的时候他疯得答不上来，可我一直没法不去想这件事。”

column1: How are you supposed to have any privacy when fools keep walking in and interrupting?
column2: “老有蠢货走进来打断，还怎么可能有半点隐私？”

column1: Sorry, but I am not available right now. Go bother someone else.
column2: “抱歉，可我现在没空。去烦别人吧。”

column1: What part of Hands to your Damn Self" do you have trouble understanding?"
column2: “你到底哪部分听不懂‘把手放回你那该死的自己身上’？”

column1: As you get close to the mushrooms, the man nearby speaks up.
column2: 你靠近那些蘑菇时，旁边的男人开口了。

column1: Peering into the crate, you see rows of potion bottles. Extending a hand towards the crate, the man nearby growls a low warning.
column2: 你往板条箱里看，看见一排排药水瓶。你向箱子伸出手，旁边的男人低低地吼出一声警告。

column1: The guard dismissively waves you away, buried in his paperwork.
column2: 卫兵不耐烦地挥手把你赶走，自己埋在文书堆里。

column1: The guard is grumbling over his gigantic stack of paperwork.
column2: 卫兵对着他那一大摞文书抱怨个不停。

column1: There isn't anything that jumps out at you.
column2: 没什么东西特别引起你的注意。

column1: These plants look ready to pick, and could prove useful.
column2: 这些植物看起来可以采了，也许用得上。

column1: This chest is empty.
column2: 这只箱子是空的。

column1: You are pricked by the plant's sharp thorns.
column2: 你被植物锋利的刺扎到了。

column1: You dozed off for a few moments, and wake up alone. Your meal is wrapped up neatly on the floor nearby with an attached note.
column2: 你迷糊了片刻，醒来时只剩下自己。你的饭包得整整齐齐，放在附近的地板上，还附了一张纸条。

column1: You leaf through several of the books piled on this shelf. After a moment, the barkeep approaches you.
column2: 你翻了翻这架子上堆着的几本书。过了一会儿，酒保向你走来。

column1: You share a carefree romp on a mountain of pillows in a dark corner upstairs. It's obvious that he doesn't get this opportunity very often, and he is very enthusiastic.
column2: 你们在楼上暗角的一座枕头山上无所顾忌地欢爱了一场。显然这种机会他并不常有，他热情得很。

column1: You hear a strange noise.
column2: 你听见一阵奇怪的声音。

column1: A scrap of paper with a note is sitting inside the open drawer here.
column2: 这里打开的抽屉里放着一张写了字的纸片。

column1: After drying off by the fire, you all avail yourselves of the huts and the night passes without further incident.
column2: 在火边烤干身子之后，你们各自进棚屋安顿，一夜再无意外。

column1: After the fire dies down, you all avail yourselves of the huts, and the night passes without further incident.
column2: 火势弱下去之后，你们各自进棚屋安顿，一夜再无意外。

column1: Bato beams at the compliment and quietly busies himself with preparing the food, while Greave shoots you a conspiratory glance, a sheepish grin showing through his beard.
column2: Bato 听了夸奖，喜形于色，安静地忙着准备食物，Greave 则朝你投来一个心照不宣的眼神，胡须间露出腼腆的笑。

column1: Bato clears his throat.
column2: Bato 清了清嗓子。

column1: Bato fixes a smug gaze on Greave while he starts chopping up the vegetables.
column2: Bato 一边开始切蔬菜，一边得意地盯着 Greave。

column1: Bato is puffing himself out proudly in characteristic fashion.
column2: Bato 正以他一贯的样子，自豪地把自己鼓起来。

column1: Both Bato and Greave are looking at you expectantly.
column2: Bato 和 Greave 都期待地看着你。

column1: Greave closes his eyes and hurriedly strips off his pants, throwing them on the ground near the fire with a wet slap. His face is bright red.
column2: Greave 闭上眼睛，急忙把裤子褪下来，湿淋淋地啪一声甩到火边的地上。他的脸红得发亮。

column1: Greave looks at you, exasperated.
column2: Greave 看着你，一脸不耐烦。

column1: Greave seems uncomfortable for a while, but as the night wears on and the warmth of the fire soaks into his skin, his posture relaxes and his familiar smile returns to his face.
column2: Greave 有一阵子显得不自在，但随着夜晚过去，火的温暖渗进他的皮肤，他的姿态放松下来，脸上又回到那熟悉的笑容。

column1: In the morning, everyone is dry and dressed, and when everyone is ready to go, Greave playfully reaches out and scratches Bato's chest.
column2: 到了早上，每个人都已晾干，穿戴整齐。等所有人准备出发时，Greave 玩闹地伸出手，挠了挠 Bato 的胸口。

column1: It seems like today is off to a good start.
column2: 看来今天开了个好头。

column1: The conversation is lively, and you enjoy an easy night chatting by the fire with two of the finest friends you've made in recent memory.
column2: 谈话很热闹。你和近来结交的两位最棒的朋友在火边轻松地聊了一夜。

column1: The food isn't wonderful, but Bato does the best he can with what is at hand.
column2: 食物算不上好，但 Bato 已经就手头的东西尽了力。

column1: There is a note tied to this sack.
column2: 这只袋子上系着一张纸条。

column1: When the fire dies and it comes time to retire, Greave stands, defiantly displaying his body to both of you one last time before laughing and forfeiting the contest to his opponent.
column2: 火灭了，到了歇下的时候，Greave 站起来，挑衅似的最后一次向你们两人展示他的身体，然后大笑，向对手认了输。

column1: You devise all kinds of comparisons to put the two men through, measuring the width, thickness, and loft of the hair covering both their bodies, but eventually the contest breaks down into laughing and swapping stories.
column2: 你想出各种各样的比较，让这两个男人挨个接受衡量，测量覆盖他们两人身体的毛发的宽度、厚度和蓬松度，但最后比试崩成了大笑和互换故事。

column1: It reads : Only those who dare appraise a life against coin may enter.
column2: 上面写着：唯有敢于以钱币衡量一条性命的人，方可进入。

column1: The chunk of slag you are carrying comes to mind. Will you place the Mercenary Soul upon the pedestal?
column2: 你想起自己带着的那块熔渣。要把佣兵之魂放上基座吗？

column1: The pedestal is worn with moisture and caked with dried on salt. There is an inscription on the very top.
column2: 基座被湿气磨损，结着干硬的盐。最顶端有一段铭文。

column1: You decide to hold on to the Mercenary Soul for now. Perhaps it can be of use elsewhere.

column2: 一具旧护甲人偶。这一具在店铺屋檐下，所以比它那具日晒雨淋的邻居状况好得多。

column2: 这是一具旧护甲人偶。即便在风雨和疏于照料把它摧残之前，它大概也已经被用得很旧了。

column2: Stephan 的水晶与宝石工艺

column1: There is a suspicious amount of seating in the street with direct line of sight to the blacksmith's workstation. Hmm.
column2: 街上有多得可疑的座位，视线直直对着铁匠的工作台。嗯。

column1: There's nothing inside but a few scraps of cloth.
column2: 里面什么也没有，只有几块布片。

column2: 这家老裁缝铺里满是各式人偶。其中一些逼真得让你几乎以为它们会动。

column1: You feel uncomfortable, as though you are being watched.
column2: 你感到不自在，仿佛正被人看着。

column1: You have no idea what a "Tem" is.
column2: 你完全不知道“Tem”是什么。

column1: A shiver runs down your spine.
column2: 一阵战栗顺着你的脊背爬下去。

column2: 过了一会儿，书开始肿胀起泡，Borgnina 的祷告完成时，它炸成一道灰柱。\n\n什么也没剩下，只有一块锯齿状的黑石。

column1: After only a moment, he's eaten the entire thing. \n\nZantanak pulls a glistening, black chunk of stone out of his mouth and hands it to you.
column2: 只过了一会儿，他就把整本吃完了。\n\nZantanak 从嘴里掏出一块湿亮的黑石，递给你。

column2: Borgnina 把手伸进兜帽，揪下一绺头发。她把它绕成一圈，围着那本怪书铺好，然后花了一点时间低声祷告。

column1: The moment you flip open the book, the pages fly apart and the book is gone.
column2: 你刚把书翻开，书页就飞散，书不见了。

column2: 这里的桌上放着一本怪书。它用薄而苍白的皮革装订，带着刺鼻的气味。

column2: Zantanak 从桌上拿起书，没有打开，就把它举到脸前，开始吃。

column1: You decide to hold on to the Assassin Soul for now. Perhaps it can be of use elsewhere.

column1: You make an offering of the Assassin Soul, a bit of slag forged from the destruction of many weapons.

column1: In the lantern light, you can see that one side of the bed is heavily bowed, as though the person who slept on this side was much, much heavier.
column2: 灯笼光下，你能看见床的一侧严重塌陷，仿佛睡在这一侧的人要重得多、重得多。

column1: Moria just sighs and shakes her head.
column2: Moria 只是叹了口气，摇了摇头。

column1: The whimsical decorations on this chest seem to mark it as a child's toybox. There are still a few mouldering toys inside, and they appear to be all very boyish.
column2: 这只箱子上那些异想天开的装饰，似乎标明它是一只孩子的玩具箱。里面还剩几件霉烂的玩具，看上去全都很有男孩气。

column1: There is a stack of paper and charcoal in this end table. There are what appear to be children's drawings on some of the pages. There are five figures holding hands, apparently the very picture of a happy family.
column2: 这张边柜里有一叠纸和木炭。有几页上似乎是儿童画。五个手拉手的人影，正是一幅幸福家庭的图画。

column1: There is still a bit of fuel in this lantern.
column2: 这盏灯笼里还有一点燃料。

column1: This fuel in this furnace is mouldering and damp.
column2: 这炉子里的燃料又霉又潮。

column1: At the very least it is an expensive luxury item. Perhaps someone will buy it.
column2: 起码它是一件昂贵的奢侈品。也许有人会买。

column1: It appears as though this area was used for some kind of public event.
column2: 看来这一带曾被用来举办某种公共活动。

column1: The axe lodged in this stump appears to be very thoroughly stuck, but you might be able to free it if you are strong enough.
column2: 嵌在这截树桩里的斧头看起来卡得死死的，但你要是力气够大，也许能把它拔出来。

column1: The old wood complains loudly as you wedge the axe free, but come free it does. Its home in the stump has seemingly protected its edge from the rust that covers its heel.
column2: 你把斧头楔出来时，老木头大声抱怨，可它到底是出来了。它嵌在树桩里的日子似乎护住了刃口，没让覆在斧跟上的锈沾上去。

column1: The table is covered with dirty bottles, most of them empty, but one still has its stopper on tight. It doesn't appear to be a potion, but rather an aromatic extracted from flowers.
column2: 桌上满是脏瓶子，大多数是空的，但有一只瓶塞仍塞得很紧。它看起来不是药水，而是从花中提取的芳香液。

column2: 木板嘎吱一声让开，露出封在后面的房间。

column1: There is a rusted key inside the drawer here.
column2: 这里的抽屉里有一把生锈的钥匙。

column1: This cauldron is full of scummy, stagnant rainwater, and is seething with bug larvae. It hasn't been used in a very long time.
column2: 这口大锅里满是结着浮渣的死雨水，里面爬满了虫子的幼虫。它已经很久没被用过了。

column1: He closes his eyes and takes a sharp breath. For a few long moments, he just breathes, until eventually he reaches up with a grubby hand and fondles the amulet gently.
column2: 他闭上眼，猛地吸了一口气。有好长一会儿，他只是呼吸，直到终于用一只肮脏的手伸上去，轻轻抚弄那块护符。

column1: His hand is trembling.
column2: 他的手在发抖。

column1: The goblin from before is gone.
column2: 先前那个哥布林不见了。

column1: The goblin looks up at you with desperate eyes, too weak to move.
column2: 哥布林抬眼看你，目光绝望，虚弱得动弹不得。

column1: There is a goblin here, slumped against the wall in the firelight. He is clearly distraught, weak, and not a threat to you.
column2: 这里有一个哥布林，在火光里瘫靠着墙。他显然心烦意乱，虚弱不堪，对你构不成威胁。

column1: There is a plain-looking amulet on the altar here, arranged purposefully. It seems as though it was to be used for some sort of ritual.
column2: 这里的祭坛上有一块样子普通的护符，摆放得很刻意。似乎是要用于某种仪式。

column1: This urn contains several bottles, most of them broken, but one appears to still be sealed tightly.
column2: 这只瓮里有好几只瓶子，大多数碎了，但有一只似乎仍密封得很紧。

column1: When he notices you, he croaks out a whispered plea, and points to his neck. You can see there is a clean band of skin about his throat, as though he had been wearing something that was removed.
column2: 他注意到你时，用沙哑的声音挤出一声低语般的恳求，并指向自己的脖子。你能看见他喉咙处有一圈干净的皮肤，仿佛他曾经戴着什么，后来被取走了。

column1: With the last of the undead silenced, you are able to take the amulet from the altar.
column2: 最后的亡灵归于寂静之后，你得以从祭坛上取走护符。

column1: You fasten the amulet around the goblin's neck, and it settles into the clean spot.
column2: 你把护符系在哥布林的脖子上，它正好落入那圈干净的印痕里。

column1: That book is the only clue you have. You'd better take it with you.
column2: 那本书是你仅有的线索。你最好带上它。

column1: The floor is laid out in a ceremonial medallion. Words are carved into the outer ring.
column2: 地面铺成一枚仪式纹章。外圈刻着文字。

column1: The temple behind you is beginning to fill with water. There's no going back now.
column2: 你身后的神殿开始灌进水。现在已经回不去了。

column1: There is a chute in the chasm above you here. You are able to climb up through it by using these high rocks as a stepping stone.
column2: 你上方的裂隙里有一条通道。你可以借这些高岩当踏脚石，顺着它爬上去。

column1: There is a loud rumble from the other room. The book falls off the table and onto the floor.
column2: 另一个房间传来响亮的隆隆声。书从桌上掉到了地板上。

column1: This statue has an inscription around the base. It reads : \n"I will watch as you suffer and die."
column2: 这尊雕像的底座周围有一段铭文。上面写着：\n“我会看着你受苦、死去。”
