column2: 他缓慢地、怀着极大的敬意，把蛋糕从箱子里捧出来，像托起某种奖杯一样高高举起。

column1: The chest is fitted with an unusal, circular lock which lacks a keyhole. While playing with the lock, you notice that it can be rotated, and it emits a quiet clunking noise.
column2: 这口箱子装有一把不寻常的圆形锁，没有钥匙孔。你摆弄这把锁时，发现它可以转动，还会发出轻轻的闷响。

column1: The chest is fitted with an unusual, circular lock which lacks a keyhole. While playing with the lock, you notice that it can be rotated, and it emits a quiet clunking noise.
column2: 这口箱子装有一把不寻常的圆形锁，没有钥匙孔。你摆弄这把锁时，发现它可以转动，还会发出轻轻的闷响。

column1: The lock emits a loud clanking noise. You take a moment to try and memorize the combination.
column2: 锁发出一声响亮的哐当。你花了点时间，试着把这组密码记住。

column1: The lock jumps outward a little, and the chest lid automatically pops open.
column2: 锁向外弹出一点，箱盖自动弹开了。

column1: The sign reads "Rosewood Teahouse Menu" in bold calligraphy across the top.
column2: 牌子顶部用粗重的书法写着“玫瑰木茶馆菜单”。

column1: The varnish on these tables has mostly flaked off, and the exposed wood is quite damp and mouldy. It is hard to imagine that they have been used recently.
column2: 这些桌子上的清漆大多已经剥落，露出的木头又湿又发霉。很难想象它们最近被人用过。

column1: There is a small scrap of paper hidden underneath one of legs on this bed.
column2: 这张床有一条腿底下藏着一小片纸。

column1: This small sack is made of a soft, white and grey pelt. You pick it up loosen the tie, and see that it is filled with coins.
column2: 这个小袋子是用柔软的、白灰相间的毛皮做成的。你把它捡起来，松开系绳，看见里面装满了钱币。

column1: Would you like to take it?
column2: 你想拿走它吗？

column1: You are unsure if this sign has been altered by vandals, or whether the gateau really is that good.
column2: 你拿不准这牌子是被蓄意破坏者改过，还是这蛋糕真有那么好。

column1: You get halfway through the instructions before the mechanism lets out a loud noise. Perhaps the locking mechanism reset itself.
column2: 你才按说明做到一半，机关就发出一声巨响。也许锁的机关自己复位了。

column1: You lift up the leg and slide the piece of paper out from underneath.
column2: 你抬起床腿，把那张纸从底下抽出来。

column1: You take the note you found from under the bed and follow the instructions written on it.
column2: 你拿出床底下找到的那张字条，照着上面的说明去做。

column1: You turn the lock in both directions by varying degrees for a while, but to no avail.
column2: 你把锁朝两个方向转了各种角度，转了好一会儿，毫无结果。

column1: You unfold the note. There are a bunch of circles drawn on it, and each one has a curved arrow and a number written inside.
column2: 你展开字条。上面画着一堆圆圈，每个圆圈里都写着一个弯曲的箭头和一个数字。

column1: A later entry follows up.
column2: 后面还跟着一则更晚的记录。

column1: In the back cover of this book, there is a key pressed into the paper.
column2: 这本书的封底内侧，有一把钥匙压进纸页里。

column1: Some pages are particularly worn. On them are some footnotes detailing the repeated incarceration of an orc named "Odluk".
column2: 有几页磨损得特别厉害。上面的脚注详述一个名叫 Odluk 的兽人屡次入狱的经过。

column1: The last entry you can find pertaining to Odluk reads as follows.
column2: 你能找到的、与 Odluk 有关的最后一则记录如下。

column1: The letter is signed, "Lord Maxim Spartill".
column2: 这封信的署名是“领主 Maxim Spartill”。

column1: There are a few items still strewn across this dressing table. A few of them appear to be valuable.
column2: 这张梳妆台上还散落着几件东西。其中几件看起来值钱。

column1: There is a folded note conspicuously tucked into this bookshelf.
column2: 这书架上显眼地夹着一张折起来的字条。

column1: There is a recently-added drawing on the bottom of a naked singing orc and a noblewoman with something leaking out of her ear. \n\nShe looks very surprised.
column2: 底部有一幅新添的画，画着一个光着身子唱歌的兽人，和一个耳朵里渗出什么东西的贵妇。\n\n她看上去非常惊讶。

column1: There is a small book forgotten in the bottom corner of this chest. Reading material for the guard, perhaps.
column2: 这口箱子的底角里遗忘着一本小书。也许是给卫兵的读物。

column1: This bookshelf has a few rotting books with dungeon records, including the names and transgressions of several residents.
column2: 这书架上有几本正在腐烂的书，记载着地牢记录，包括数名囚徒的姓名和罪状。

column1: This desk has a half-penned letter still resting on it.
column2: 这张书桌上还搁着一封写到一半的信。

column1: This looks like duty rosters for the guard rotations. They haven't been opened in a very long time.
column2: 这看起来是卫兵轮值的勤务表。已经很久没有被打开过了。

column1: This signpost is very old. It reads, \n"Breathtaking harmony heard the isle over! Come and treat your ears to the Royal Seamen's Chorus, playing all week!"
column2: 这块路牌非常古老。上面写着，\n“全岛都听得见的惊人和声！来让你们的耳朵享享福吧，皇家水手合唱团，演满一整周！”

column1: This unassuming end table has stood forgotten for many years. When you open it, you find a key that has managed to escape the notice of looters. Until now, that is.
column2: 这张不起眼的边几被遗忘了许多年。你打开它，发现一把逃过了掠夺者注意的钥匙。至少，直到现在。

column1: As you examine the broken lantern, a small length of golden metal tumbles out of it.
column2: 你检查这盏破灯笼时，一小截金色金属从里面滚了出来。

column1: It looks as though someone tore the casing off of this node. There are wires spilling out of it, and there is a conspicuous gap in the golden circuitry inside. Something has clearly been removed.
column2: 看起来有人把这个节点的外壳撕掉了。电线从里面溢出来，内部的金色电路有一处显眼的缺口。显然有东西被取走了。

column1: It looks as though the connection pin you took from the lantern might fit into the gap in the circuitry.
column2: 看起来你从灯笼里取出的那根连接销，也许能嵌进电路的缺口。

column1: Some kind of metallic pillar. It is tightly sealed.
column2: 某种金属柱。封得严严实实。

column1: Some kind of metallic pillar. It looks like someone has tried, unsuccessfully, to break into it.
column2: 某种金属柱。看起来有人试过把它砸开，没有成功。

column1: There are some scraps of paper on this table, but nothing has any legible text on it.
column2: 这张桌子上有些纸片，但没有任何能辨认的文字。

column1: There is a short length of rotted twine stuck between two of the boards on the top of this table. It is not worth taking.
column2: 这张桌面的两块板之间卡着一小段腐烂的细绳。不值得拿走。

column1: There is an empty ceramic cup caked over with dust, but nothing else of note.
column2: 有一只空陶杯，结着厚厚一层灰，除此之外没有什么值得注意的。

column1: There is nothing else of interest in this end table.
column2: 这张边几里没有别的有意思的东西了。

column1: This is a long-dry basin, perhaps for water or maybe to serve as a collection plate.
column2: 这是一只干涸已久的盆，也许用来盛水，也许当作奉献盘。

column1: This lantern looks like it has been pried open, and does not appear to be in working order.
column2: 这盏灯笼看起来被人撬开过，而且似乎已经不能用了。

column1: When you touch the pin to the circuitry, a strong shock jolts your fingers! You'll have to be more careful on your next attempt.
column2: 你把销子碰到电路上时，一股强烈的电击刺痛了你的手指！下次你得更小心。

column1: You carefully slot the pin into the gap on the circuitry and quickly snap your hand away as a powerful blast of electricity surges through the node! You can feel the structure humming with power!
column2: 你小心地把销子插进电路的缺口，一股强大的电流猛地涌过节点，你连忙把手抽开！你能感到这结构正嗡嗡地充满能量！

column1: You find a small book in the drawer. It has obviously been very well-used, and the cover is torn off.
column2: 你在抽屉里找到一本小书。它显然被用得很旧，封面已经撕掉了。

column1: It reads : There is no sting worse than that of Zosark. Prove you can endure it.
column2: 上面写着：没有比佐萨克的蜇刺更痛的。证明你受得住。

column1: The pedestal is cluttered with flaking rust. There is an inscription on the very top.
column2: 基座上堆满片片剥落的锈。最顶部有一行铭文。

column1: A blast of superheated air stings your eyes and throws you off.
column2: 一股过热的气浪刺痛你的眼睛，把你甩开。

column1: A quick search reveals an access panel and some inner mechanism.
column2: 迅速一搜，你发现一块检修面板和一些内部机关。

column1: A spray of burning hot oil sends you reeling. A lighter touch may be needed.
column2: 一股滚烫的油喷出来，打得你连连后退。也许需要更轻的手法。

column1: A wave of hot air floors you. Your eyebrows are long gone.
column2: 一股热浪把你掀倒在地。你的眉毛早就没了。

column1: After a brief search, you locate some kind of mechanism in a panel on the side of this statue.
column2: 短暂搜寻之后，你在这座雕像侧面的一块面板里找到了某种机关。

column1: As before, you have found some kind of access panel on the statue that reveals a mechanism.
column2: 和先前一样，你在雕像上找到了某种检修面板，露出一套机关。

column1: Everything inside this mechanism is piping hot, and you burned yourself. You'll have to be more careful and try again.
column2: 这套机关里面的一切都滚烫，你把自己烫伤了。你得更小心，然后再试一次。

column1: It just got a lot hotter in here.
column2: 这儿一下子热多了。

column1: It looks as though your tampering is having... side effects.
column2: 看来你的摆弄正在产生……副作用。

column1: Searching the chest a second time, you find a small switch hidden under the lip.
column2: 你第二次搜查这口箱子，发现箱沿底下藏着一个小开关。

column1: The battery clicks into place and the fire jet shuts off.
column2: 电池咔哒一声卡到位，喷焰熄灭了。

column1: The depleted battery you found looks like it would fit perfectly into the impression in this jackal's chest.
column2: 你找到的那块耗尽的电池，看起来正好能嵌进这座胡狼胸口的凹痕。

column1: There is an unusual indentation in the chest of this jackal statue, but no sign of an exposed mechanism.
column2: 这座胡狼雕像的胸口有一处不寻常的凹痕，但没有外露机关的迹象。

column1: There was a surge of fuel and an explosion! You managed to suffer only minor burns.
column2: 燃料猛地涌上来，爆炸了！你总算只受了点轻微烧伤。

column1: There was nothing inside of this chest.
column2: 这口箱子里面什么都没有。

column1: This mechanism is barely even hidden.
column2: 这套机关几乎根本没藏。

column1: This statue also appears to have a mechanism inside.
column2: 这座雕像里面似乎也有一套机关。

column1: You cut yourself on an unseen sharp edge.
column2: 你被一道看不见的锋利边缘割伤了。

column1: You disconnect a pressure regulator, and the fire dies out.
column2: 你断开一个压力调节器，火灭了。

column1: You gently shut off the fuel valve.
column2: 你轻轻关掉燃料阀。

column1: You kink a fuel line, and hear something further inside the mechanism break.
column2: 你把一根燃料管折弯，听见机关更深处有什么东西断了。

column1: You manage to choke off a fuel valve, and the fire stops.
column2: 你设法掐死一个燃料阀，火停了。

column1: You redirect the fuel into a hollow part of the statue, and the fires sputter out.
column2: 你把燃料引向雕像里的一处空腔，火焰噼啪着熄灭了。

column1: You search the statue, but find nothing of particular note.
column2: 你搜查这座雕像，但没发现什么特别值得注意的。

column1: You spot a panel on the floor that appears to be out of place. It offers access to some kind of mechanism.
column2: 你发现地板上有一块看起来位置不对的面板。它通向某种机关。

column1: You've hopelessly mangled whatever that mechanism was.
column2: 你把那套机关彻底绞烂了，已经看不出它原来是什么，没救了。

column1: And that's how you felt when you and I married, Rangda?
column2: “所以你和我结婚的时候，你就是这种感觉吗，Rangda？”

column1: At least, we're told that it's supposed to be. In reality they just exploit our eagerness to make us work harder. Most women go through five or six husbands in their lives, because there's always someone a little better, a little stronger, someone with a bigger cock.
column2: “至少，别人是这么告诉我们的，说理应如此。实际上他们只是利用我们的急切，好让我们更拼命地干活。大多数女人一辈子要过五六个丈夫，因为总有人更好一点，更强壮一点，鸡巴更大一点。”

column1: By the time she is free of it, if she is ever free of it at all, she'll be a withered old woman, too stretched and spent to chase after her dried-out dreams.
column2: “等她摆脱的时候，如果她真能摆脱的话，她已经是个干瘪的老太婆，被撑开、被耗尽，追不动自己那些枯干的梦。”

column1: Even if she does love her husband, she's little more than a sacrifice on the altar of the orcish nation.
column2: “就算她真的爱自己的丈夫，她也不过是兽人国度祭坛上的一件祭品。”

column1: Everybody would be celebrating except for the bride, of course. She puts on a smile for her family, but she is screaming inside, being signed away as little more than breeding stock.
column2: “当然，除了新娘，人人都在庆祝。她对家人挤出笑容，心里却在尖叫，被签字送走，跟种畜没什么两样。”

column1: Hah! Don't make me laugh. I'd rather fall on my blade than spend another day with you, and I'm doing just fine here, thanks.
column2: “哈！别逗我笑。我宁可扑到自己的刀上，也不想再跟你多过一天，而且我在这儿过得挺好，谢了。”

column1: He works hard his whole life to stand out in a sea of men who will probably never get to be fathers, so that just maybe, a woman will pick him. It's a huge success when it actually happens.
column2: “他一辈子拼命干活，好在那片大概永远当不成父亲的男人海里冒出头，这样也许，会有一个女人挑中他。这事真发生的时候，就是巨大的成功。”

column1: How many years has it been? Seven? Nine? And you think I'd spend that time pining after the woman who threw me away and cost me everything? Well I'd say we're pretty well even now, so good job. I owe you nothing.
column2: “多少年了？七年？九年？你以为我会把那段时间花在苦恋那个把我扔掉、让我失去一切的女人身上？哼，我看我们现在差不多扯平了，干得漂亮。我什么都不欠你。”

column1: However hard we work, we're nothing more than olives, to be chewed, pitted, and spat upon the floor. What a fool I was.
column2: “无论我们怎么拼命，也不过是橄榄，被人嚼、去核，再吐到地上。我以前真是个傻瓜。”

column1: I bet they were so happy. Orc men are always excited at their weddings. I'm one of the lucky few", he thinks. "I'll get to have some babies"."
column2: “我敢说他们当时高兴极了。兽人男人在自己的婚礼上总是兴奋得很。‘我是少数幸运儿’，他心想。‘我就能有几个孩子了。’”

column1: I came to rescue you from this place! To free you from this prison so we could be together again!
column2: “我是来把你从这个地方救出去的！把你从这个监狱里救出来，这样我们就能重新在一起！”

column1: I came to rescue you. To get you off of this damned island!
column2: “我是来救你的。把你弄出这座该死的岛！”

column1: I can't go back Nazar, you know that! I've given up my entire life to come here for your sake!
column2: “我回不去了，Nazar，你知道的！我为了你放弃了整个人生，才来到这儿！”

column1: I would suggest trying to make some friends. You will probably need them.
column2: “我建议你试着交几个朋友。你大概用得着他们。”

column1: It makes me sick.
column2: “这让我恶心。”

column1: Just like how my whole life was stripped away to send me here for your sake, right? Way I see it, that makes us even, so I owe you nothing. I am years done with you, woman.
column2: “就像我的整个人生都被剥光，为了你被送到这儿来，对吧？照我看，这下我们扯平了，所以我什么都不欠你。我跟你了结好多年了，女人。”

column1: Let's go. There's nothing important here.
column2: “我们走。这儿没什么要紧的。”

column1: Let's go.
column2: “我们走。”

column1: Nazar! You are alive! I've been searching for you ever since I got here!
column2: “Nazar！你还活着！我一到这儿就一直在找你！”

column1: Nazar... I gave up everything! I threw it all away to come here and find you, so we could be together again!
column2: “Nazar……我放弃了一切！我把所有东西都扔掉，来这儿找你，好让我们重新在一起！”

column1: No, but together-
column2: “不，可是一起——”

column1: Not with you. Not back to Tsarath. Out here, I earn everything I have, and my life is difficult, but it's fair and it's mine. I don't have a selfish, short-sighted wife who can cut it off at a moment's notice.
column2: “不是跟你。也不回察拉思。在这外面，我拥有的一切都是自己挣的。我的生活艰难，可它公平，而且是我的。我没有一个自私、短视的妻子，能随时把这一切切断。”

column1: Now leave. If I ever see you again, you're going to get another sword lesson. A very short one.
column2: “现在离开。要是我再看见你，你就再上一堂剑课。非常短的一堂。”

column1: Now what am I supposed to do?
column2: “那我现在该怎么办？”

column1: Now, this is my campsite, so I'd appreciate it if you'd take your friends and leave me be. You're scaring off the game.
column2: “行了，这是我的营地，所以如果你带上你的朋友离开，别来烦我，我会很感激。你们把猎物吓跑了。”

column1: Rangda? What the hell are you doing here? Couldn't keep yourself out of trouble I assume?
column2: “Rangda？你他妈在这儿干什么？我猜你还是管不住自己，非惹麻烦不可？”

column1: Rescue me? What makes you think I need rescuing? I've never been happier in my life.
column2: “救我？你凭什么觉得我需要人救？我这辈子从没这么高兴过。”

column1: Six torches. This was a wedding celebration. An orcish one.
column2: “六支火把。这是一场婚礼庆典。兽人的。”

column1: So you could have what you want, of course. No I'm sorry I made stupid decisions that utterly ruined you". You wagered my life, Rangda! You knew this would happen and you did it anyway! Did it even occur to you that I didn't miss you? That I was glad to be rid of the whole stupid farce?"
column2: “当然是为了让你得到你想要的。没有一句‘对不起，我做了那些蠢决定，把你彻底毁了’。你拿我的命去赌，Rangda！你知道会变成这样，可你还是干了！你有没有哪怕想过，我并不想念你？想过我高兴能摆脱那整出愚蠢的闹剧？”

column1: So you managed to get yourself thrown away too, did you? You must have done something really bad this time. What do you want, Rangda?
column2: “所以你也把自己搞成被扔掉的了，是吗？你这次肯定干了非常坏的事。你想要什么，Rangda？”

column1: So? You don't have a way off the island. Nobody does.
column2: “所以呢？你没有离开这座岛的办法。谁都没有。”

column1: Together my ass, Rangda! I'm going nowhere with you, now or ever. You've done enough damage to me already!
column2: “一起个屁，Rangda！我现在不会跟你去任何地方，以后也永远不会。你已经把我害得够惨了！”

column1:
Was I too harsh? 
No, don't answer that, I don't actually care. 

Let's be off.
column2:
“我太狠了吗？
不，别回答，我其实不在乎。

我们走吧。”

column1: Welcome to Lukatt, by the way. Here, you can do anything you want. No laws at all! Enjoy.
column2: “顺便说一句，欢迎来到卢卡特。在这儿，你想干什么就干什么。根本没有法律！好好享受。”

column1: What? But this place is a prison, and polluted with monsters besides.
column2: “什么？可这地方是一座监狱，而且还被怪物污染了。”

column1: What? You don't want to leave?
column2: “什么？你不想离开？”

column1: You know that isn't true, Nazar. I loved you dearly. I still do.
column2: “你知道那不是真的，Nazar。我曾经深深地爱你。现在也爱。”

column1: You shouldn't have come here, Rangda.
column2: “你不该来这儿，Rangda。”

column1: Someone has been camping here recently. The embers of this fire are still warm.
column2: 最近有人在这儿扎过营。这火堆的余烬还是温的。

column1: A chunk of blackened meat lies inside the cage. It would be easy enough to reach through the bars and take it...
column2: 笼子里躺着一块焦黑的肉。把手伸过栏杆拿走它，容易得很……

column1: A couple of slices look edible, but they are certainly past their prime.
column2: 有几片看起来还能吃，但肯定已经过了最好的时候。

column1: A rusted iron key sits inside the bucket. Take a closer look?
column2: 桶里放着一把生锈的铁钥匙。要靠近看看吗？

column1: A small paper tag is tied to the key with some string. The writing on it reads "grounds maintenance".
column2: 一把小纸标签用绳子系在钥匙上。上面写着“场地维护”。

column1: A small pouch has been left on the ground here. It feels light when you lift it up, but there are a couple of useful items inside.
column2: 这里的地上留着一个小袋子。你把它拿起来时觉得很轻，但里面有几件有用的东西。

column1: After some winding, the crank locks into place.
column2: 转了几圈之后，摇柄卡到位，锁住了。

column1: Magic runes have been hastily painted on the floor here, and are outlined by lit candles. You feel subtle vibrations coming from the runes, and they make you feel somewhat light-headed.
column2: 这里的地板上被人匆忙画上了魔力符文，并用点燃的蜡烛勾出轮廓。你感到符文传来细微的震动，它们让你有些头晕。

column1: On this stump is a folded-over piece of paper weighed down by a small rock.
column2: 这截树桩上有一张对折的纸，被一块小石头压着。

column1: One of the books is noticeably lighter than the others. Opening it up reveals a hollowed-out section which houses an ornate black key.
column2: 其中一本书明显比别的轻。打开一看，里面被掏空了一块，放着一把华丽的黑钥匙。

column1: Take a look inside?
column2: 要看看里面吗？

column1: Take the key with you?
column2: 要把钥匙带走吗？

column1: That is probably for the best.
column2: 这样大概最好。

column1: That is probably for the best. You place the lid back on top of the crate.
column2: 这样大概最好。你把盖子放回箱子顶上。

column1: The chest is set with a solid gold lock. However, the lock seems to have been fitted incorrectly -- it wobbles around in place. Try opening it?
column2: 这口箱子装有一把纯金锁。不过，这锁似乎装得不对——它在原位晃来晃去。试着打开吗？

column1: The lid disintegrates as you go to close it, and simply crumbles away into the box.
column2: 你去盖盖子的时候，盖子碎了，直接崩成渣，掉进箱子里。

column1: The locking mechanism falls off, and the chest opens with ease. The lock itself looks valuable, and might be worth taking.
column2: 锁的机关掉了下来，箱子轻易打开。锁本身看起来值钱，也许值得拿走。

column1: The wood comprising this chest is singed all over, and is finely coated in ash. Would you like to open it?
column2: 这口箱子的木头到处烧焦，还细细覆着一层灰。你想打开它吗？

column1: There is a funny smell inside this shed, and these crates appear to be the source...
column2: 这棚子里有一股怪味，而这些箱子似乎就是来源……

column1: There is moderate resistance when attempting to turn the crank.
column2: 试图转动摇柄时，有中等程度的阻力。

column1: These books are filled with magic runes and a handful of strange diagrams.
column2: 这些书里写满了魔力符文，还有几张奇怪的图解。

column1: Would you like to read the note?
column2: 你想读这张字条吗？

column1: You can attempt to extinguish the candles if you wish.
column2: 如果你愿意，可以试着熄灭这些蜡烛。

column1: You slide the lid off the topmost crate and see piles of quiche slices stuffed inside. This was apparently the groundkeepers' favourite.
column2: 你滑开最上面那口箱子的盖子，看见里面塞着一堆乳蛋饼切片。这显然曾是场地管理员们的最爱。

column1: A pamphlet catches your eye. It describes how this cult is centred around the worship of the great and powerful "Matthaxus". There aren't any useful details regarding just what Matthaxus is, but the praise in this print is deliriously overzealous.
column2: 一本小册子吸引了你的目光。它写着这个邪教以崇拜伟大而强大的“Matthaxus”为中心。至于 Matthaxus 究竟是什么，没有任何有用的细节，但这份印刷品里的赞美狂热得近乎谵妄。

column1: Rosaline tosses her hair, obviously more relaxed now that the trouble has been dealt with.
column2: Rosaline 甩了甩头发。麻烦已经解决，她显然放松多了。

column1: She stares at the ceiling for a moment, apparently thinking about something.
column2: 她盯着天花板看了一会儿，显然在想什么事。

column1: This chest appears to be full of typical provisions for the commune.
column2: 这口箱子里似乎装满了公社的普通补给。

column1: This drawer has a key inside of it.
column2: 这个抽屉里有一把钥匙。

column1: Inside the chest is a collection of badly-spoiled provisions. You do, however, find an unopened bottle of wine that should still be safe to consume.
column2: 箱子里是一批严重变质的补给。不过，你找到一瓶没开封的葡萄酒，应该还安全，可以喝。

column1: This water is stagnant and murky, but you catch sight of something at the bottom.
column2: 这水又滞又浑，但你看见底部有什么东西。

column1: It's probably best not to force the issue.
column2: 最好还是别强行追究这件事。

column1: Rangda is unusually quiet this morning. She doesn't look like she slept very well.
column2: Rangda 今天早上异常安静。她看起来睡得不太好。

column1: She picks up on your looking at her almost immediately. She opens her mouth as if to speak, but is overtaken by a yawn instead, and averts her eyes.
column2: 她几乎立刻就察觉到你在看她。她张开嘴，像是要说话，却被一个哈欠抢了先，然后移开了目光。

column1: Your party hunkers down in the old courthouse for the night. It has nothing in the way of comfortable furniture, but it's secure and has plenty of room, so it promises to be an easy night.
column2: 你的队伍在这座老法院里将就着过夜。这里谈不上舒适的家具，但安全，地方也宽敞，看来会是安稳的一夜。

column1: The drums have been ensorcelled and are ready for use. Once they've been lit, this well should suffice as a...\n *The note is ripped here, cutting off the rest of the journal page*
column2: “鼓已施法完毕，可以使用。一旦点燃，这口井应当足以当作……”\n *笔记在此处被撕毁，日志这一页的其余内容就此中断*

column1: After the gruesome assault, you quickly return your attention to the well. Its surface shimmers softly, and you feel your gaze once again being drawn into it. Hopefully this will let you escape from this nightmare.
column2: 这场惨烈的袭击过后，你迅速把注意力转回井上。井面轻轻闪烁，你感到目光再一次被吸进去。但愿这能让你逃出这场噩梦。

column1: As the mayor speaks, he lurches forward, his body swelling and spilling forth from his dirty finery.
column2: 镇长说话时猛地向前一冲，身体膨胀起来，从脏污的华服里涌溢而出。

column1: As you approach the well, the air grows taut, and a grating voice cuts through the oppressive silence.
column2: 你走近井时，空气绷紧了，一个刺耳的声音划破了压抑的寂静。

column1: As you enter the room, a sensation of nausea crashes over you like a wave.
column2: 你一进这房间，一阵恶心就像浪一样砸过来。

column1: As you near the edge of town, the path feels like it's getting longer and longer.
column2: 你靠近镇子边缘时，这条路仿佛越走越长。

column1: As you step outside, a dull vertigo tickles your mind.
column2: 你一踏出门外，一阵钝钝的眩晕就搔过心神。

column1: The clear water of the well shimmers silently in the dark, reflecting the cloudy night sky.
column2: 井里的清水在黑暗中无声地闪烁，映着多云的夜空。

column1: The clear water of the well shimmers silently in the night, reflecting the cloudy sky and the flickering flames of the nearby fire drum.
column2: 井里的清水在夜里无声地闪烁，映着多云的天空，以及附近火鼓上摇曳的火焰。

column1: The firelight reflecting in the water's surface is oddly alluring. Your gaze lingers for a moment, and a vague sense of nausea washes over you.
column2: 映在水面的火光怪异地诱人。你的目光停了一停，一阵模糊的恶心漫上来。

column1: The stranger makes a sudden gesture, and you feel your vision growing dim, a furious howl echoing through the still darkness.
column2: 陌生人突然做了个手势，你感到视线暗下去，一声狂怒的嚎叫在静止的黑暗里回荡。

column1: The water reflects a sickening sky with clouds like streaking blood on glass. You hope against hope that you can pass back through to the other side, but nothing seems to be happening.
column2: 水面映出一片令人作呕的天空，云如玻璃上拖开的血痕。你明知无望，仍盼着能穿回另一边，可什么都没有发生。

column1: Things appear to be back to normal for now, but there's no telling how long they will stay that way. You'd best escape this place while you can.
column2: 眼下一切似乎恢复了正常，可谁也说不准能维持多久。你最好趁还能走，逃出这里。

column1: When you regain your composure, the room appears as if it has been remade in the image of a nightmare.
column2: 等你恢复镇定，这房间仿佛已被重塑成一场噩梦的模样。

column1: When your vision returns, the path is again clear. A foul odour lingers on the air, but there are no signs that anyone other than you has been here for many long years.
column2: 视力恢复后，路又清楚了。空气里残留着恶臭，可没有迹象表明，这许多年来除你之外还有谁来过。

column1: You are suddenly snapped back to your senses by a thumping noise in the building behind you. You are not alone here.
column2: 身后那栋建筑里一声闷响，猛地把你拉回神志。这里不只有你。

column1: You eventually reach a crude stone barricade blocking your path, and when you turn to look, the town is still directly behind you. Some sinister force is holding you here.
column2: 你终于走到一道粗糙的石路障前，路被挡住了。你回头看，镇子仍正正地在你身后。有某种阴恶的力量把你困在这里。

column1: You have stepped out of the nightmare, but there's no telling if it might drag you back in. You'd best leave while you can.
column2: 你已经走出了这场噩梦，可谁也说不准它会不会再把你拖回去。你最好趁还能走就离开。

column1: You may finally be able to escape.
column2: 你也许终于能够逃脱了。

column1: It looks as though scavengers have already picked over the supplies. There is nothing useful remaining.
column2: 看来拾荒者已经把补给翻过一遍。没有剩下什么有用的东西。

column1: There is something glittering amid the broken body.
column2: 这具破碎的身体里有什么东西在闪光。

column1: This corpse is partially eaten. Many of the bones are crushed or outright missing.
column2: 这具尸体被吃掉了一部分。许多骨头被碾碎，或者干脆不见了。

column1: This corpse looks to have been savagely mangled by a large, powerful carnivore.
column2: 这具尸体看着是被一头庞大有力的食肉兽野蛮撕烂的。

column1: This corpse was cleanly torn in two
column2: 这具尸体被整齐地撕成了两半。

column1: This person evidently got some distance away from the others before being felled.
column2: 这个人显然在倒下之前，已经离开其他人一段距离。

column1: This person never had a chance.
column2: 这个人根本没有机会。

column1: You find an amulet, once beautiful, but now crusted in dried blood.
column2: 你找到一枚护符，曾经美丽，如今结着一层干血。

column1: It reads : The temple is reserved for those who can withstand the soul of the mountain.
column2: 上面写着：神殿只留给能承受山岳之魂的人。

column1: Judging by the state of these corpses, these poor suckers fell down the mountainside. There are still some useful supplies among the bones.
column2: 从这些尸体的状况来看，这帮可怜的倒霉蛋是从山坡上摔下去的。骨头堆里还剩些能用的补给。

column1: The chunk of slag you are carrying comes to mind. Will you place the Mountain Soul upon the pedestal?
column2: 你想起了身上带着的那块熔渣。要把山岳之魂放上基座吗？

column1: There is an inscription on the dais here.
column2: 这里的高台上有一段铭文。

column1: You decide to hold on to the Mountain Soul for now. Perhaps it can be of use elsewhere.
column2: 你决定暂时留着山岳之魂。也许它在别处还能派上用场。

column1: You make an offering of the Mountain Soul, a bit of slag forged from the destruction of many weapons.
column2: 你献上山岳之魂，一小块由许多武器毁弃后锻成的熔渣。

column1: Spartill Lodge.
column2: “Spartill狩猎小屋。”

column1: The Babe is apparently quite far away, but it looks as though he and his band expected to get there quickly, based on the amount of supplies they prepared.
column2: “The Babe”显然相当远，可从他们准备的补给数量来看，他和他的团伙料想能很快赶到那里。

column1: A large bathing room. The men who used this lodge must have been very comfortable with one another.
column2: 一间宽大的浴室。用过这座小屋的男人们，彼此之间一定非常自在。

column1: At the bottom, conspicuously, is written the phrase \n"Mother, mother, remember me."
column2: 最下方醒目地写着这句话\n“母亲，母亲，记住我。”

column1: Beauregard fishes a key out of his doublet and just holds it in front of his face for a few long minutes. This is clearly very hard for him.
column2: Beauregard 从紧身短衣里摸出一把钥匙，只把它举在眼前，举了漫长的几分钟。这对他显然非常艰难。

column1: Beauregard sighs deeply and hangs his head, looking at the ground.
column2: Beauregard 深深叹了口气，低下头，看着地面。

column1: It appears as if this room was used for cleaning and curing game. There are a number of hooks on chains hanging from the ceiling.
column2: 这间房看来是用来清洗和腌制猎物的。天花板上垂着好些拴了链子的钩子。

column1: It seems to be a final farewell, as though he suspected that he would not be coming back.
column2: 这像是最后的告别，仿佛他怀疑自己再也不会回来。

column1: Knowing that Spartill came here at the Queen's behest, you analyze the journal carefully.
column2: 你知道 Spartill 是奉女王之命来到这里，于是仔细研读这本日志。

column1: On the inside wall of one of the shelves is a series of keyhooks, with a cold brass key still hanging, forgotten in the dark.
column2: 其中一个架子的内壁上有一排钥匙钩，一把冰凉的黄铜钥匙还挂在上面，被遗忘在黑暗里。

column1: The beds are all neatly-made. It is unlikely that anyone has been here since the proper owner last left.
column2: 床都铺得整整齐齐。自从原本的主人最后一次离开，不太可能有人来过。

column1: The final entry in this journal mentions "chasing the babe".
column2: 这本日志的最后一条提到“追逐 Babe”。

column1: These appear to be accounts of hunting expeditions. Descriptions of where the men went, landmarks they observed, game they spotted, and of course, the chases and hunts themselves.
column2: 这些看来是出猎的记录。写着那些人去了何处、看见的地标、发现的猎物，当然，还有追逐和狩猎本身。

column1: This calls to mind the image of a group of hunters enjoying their breakfast as they prepare for the day's activities.
column2: 这让人想起一群猎人吃着早餐、准备当天活动的画面。

column1: This is penned in a straightforward hand with little flourish. Though some of the pages have faded and bled, it is all still quite legible.
column2: 这字迹平实，少有花饰。尽管有些页已经褪色、洇开，整体依然相当清楚可读。

column1: This lodge has been undisturbed for a long time. There is a cozy sense of fellowship about it, despite the cobwebs.
column2: 这座小屋已经许久无人打扰。尽管结着蛛网，仍有一种温馨的情谊。

column1: You search through the groundskeeper's bookshelf.
column2: 你翻看园丁的书架。

column1: He seems confused, and doesn't even notice you.
column2: 他显得茫然，甚至没有注意到你。

column1: It looks as though the blacksmith clawed his way out of the grave.
column2: 看来铁匠是用手刨着从坟墓里爬出来的。

column1: Soon, your fingers grasp something solid, a long box. At its owner's direction, you open it and draw forth a magnificent sword.
column2: 很快，你的手指抓住一件结实的东西，一只长盒。遵照主人的示意，你打开它，抽出一柄华美的剑。

column1: The Mercenary Soul is drawn into the crystal, and it surges to life with a surprisingly violent flash.
column2: 佣兵之魂被吸进水晶，水晶猛地活过来，爆出一阵出奇暴烈的闪光。

column1: The animated corpse makes no move to attack you. A voice like the sound of a blade being quenched hisses out when you get near.
column2: 这具会动的尸体没有要攻击你的举动。你靠近时，一个声音嘶嘶响起来，像刀刃淬火。

column1: The corpse stands by calmly and watches you as you gingerly begin to sift through the earth of his open grave.
column2: 尸体平静地站在一旁，看着你小心翼翼地开始翻他敞开墓穴里的土。

column1: The forge crystal sparkles with intense heat and light.
column2: 熔炉水晶闪耀着炽烈的热与光。

column1: The piece is beautiful, precise, and elegant. The final work of a master smith whose name you never knew.
column2: 这件东西美丽、精确、优雅。一位你从不知姓名的锻造大师的最后作品。

column1: The skeletal face turns toward you. Though he has no eyes, you are certain he is looking straight at you.
column2: 那张骷髅面孔转向你。他没有眼睛，可你确信他正直视着你。

column1: The smith's body collapses into dust, and the only things left behind are his hammer and the piece he has forged for you.
column2: 铁匠的身体崩成尘土，留下的只有他的锤子，和他为你锻成的那件东西。

column1: This crystal is dull and appears covered in soot.
column2: 这颗水晶黯淡无光，看着像蒙着一层烟灰。

column1: This crystal is dull and appears covered in soot. The mercenary soul throbs in your hand as you bring it near.
column2: 这颗水晶黯淡无光，看着像蒙着一层烟灰。你把它凑近时，佣兵之魂在你掌中悸动。

column1: With one bony arm, he gestures toward the open earth behind him.
column2: 他用一只枯骨手臂，朝身后敞开的泥土示意。

column1: Without another word, the smith begins to work on your bezoar. You are unsure what he is making exactly, but he seemed to know precisely what you wanted, so you find a place to sit and let him work.
column2: 铁匠不再说话，开始加工你的牛黄。你说不准他究竟在做什么，可他似乎分毫不差地知道你想要什么，于是你找了个地方坐下，让他做。

column1: You gingerly hold out your bezoar, and the steelweaver's skeletal fingers curl around it carefully.
column2: 你小心翼翼地递出牛黄，织钢者的枯骨手指小心地把它握住。

column1: You take in the view of your surroundings from the top of this lookout tower. A short distance away is what appears to be a town in the forest below. It should be fairly easy to mark your direction and strike toward it.
column2: 你从这座瞭望塔顶打量四周。不远处，下方的林子里似乎有一座镇子。标定方向朝它走，应当相当容易。

column1: The wall is sturdier than it first seemed. You'll need to try it again.
column2: 这堵墙比起初看着结实。你得再试一次。

column1: There is a forgotten scrap of bread in this box.
column2: 这只箱子里有一小块被遗忘的面包。

column1: This wall appears to be barely holding. You might be able to break through it.
column2: 这堵墙看着勉强撑着。你也许能把它砸穿。

column1: Whatever was in this cauldron is now nothing but a foul-smelling slime.
column2: 这口大锅里曾经有过什么，如今只剩一滩恶臭的黏浆。

column1: A woman in a dull robe is praying before the altar of this abbey, her lips moving in silent homage. After a moment, she straightens and turns toward you.
column2: 一个穿着黯淡长袍的女人正在这座修道院的祭坛前祈祷，嘴唇无声翕动，致以敬意。片刻之后，她挺直身子，转向你。

column1: Borgnina appears to be uneasy.
column2: Borgnina 显得不安。

column1: Borgnina is silent for a moment. She takes a deep sigh and looks down at her hands, clad in heavy jointed armour.
column2: Borgnina 沉默了片刻。她深深叹了口气，低头看自己的手，那双手裹在厚重的关节铠甲里。

column1: Borgnina withdraws a handful of unassuming jewels from her robe and hands them to you.
column2: Borgnina 从长袍里取出一把不起眼的宝石，递给了你。

column1: It appears to be positioned in the northwest corner of the abbey, so it would make a good place for one of the jewels.
column2: 它似乎位于修道院的西北角，所以很适合放上一颗宝石。

column1: It appears to be the northeast corner of the abbey, so you drop one of the jewels into the bin.
column2: 这似乎是修道院的东北角，于是你把一颗宝石丢进了箱子。

column1: It looks as though the nuns have set up a place to watch songbirds playing in the water. It's a lovely, quiet place.
column2: 看来修女们布置了一处地方，好观赏鸣禽在水里嬉戏。这里可爱又安静。

column1: It looks as though this box is full of various soaps and personal care items. They smell quite pleasant, but they must be hard to get out here. The sisters probably make them.
column2: 这只箱子里似乎装满了各种肥皂和洗护用品。气味相当好闻，可在这外头一定很难弄到。大概是修女们自己做的。

column1: She shouts aloud, "Sisters! In the name of God, we shall purge this evil from our world! Come!"
column2: 她大声喊道：“修女们！以上帝之名，我们要把这邪恶从我们的世界净化出去！来！”

column1: Some of these items are clearly luxuries, and not strictly necessary for hygeine.
column2: 其中有些东西明显是奢侈品，对卫生并非必不可少。

column1: Suddenly she whirls around toward you, brandishing her mace menacingly.
column2: 她突然旋身转向你，威胁地挥舞着钉锤。

column1: The table is in the southwest corner of the abbey though, so it makes a good spot to plant one of the crystals.
column2: 不过这张桌子在修道院的西南角，所以很适合安放一颗水晶。

column1: There are ashes from a burnt-out stick of incense sitting here.
column2: 这里有一截燃尽的香留下的灰。

column1: These barrels have preserved meats alongside some other long-storage foodstuffs. Anyone can tell you that storing those foods in the same barrel is against religious practices, but it technically doesn't harm anything.
column2: 这些桶里装着腌肉，还有些其他耐存放的食物。谁都知道把那些食物跟腌肉放在同一只桶里有违教规，可严格说来也没什么害处。

column1: This book is certainly unbecoming of a nun, but it's not exactly demonic.
column2: 这本书确实有失修女体统，可也算不上恶魔之物。

column1: This might once have been a hallway or another room, but it has long since collapsed.
column2: 这里也许曾经是一条走廊，或另一间房，但早已坍塌。

column1: This spot appears to lay beneath the southeast corner of the abbey, however. You drop one of the jewels into the open chest.
column2: 不过，这个位置似乎位于修道院东南角的下方。你把一颗宝石丢进敞开的箱子。

column1: This stone chest lies empty.
column2: 这只石箱是空的。

column1: This table is laid out with some pieces for a simple dice game. The player with the red pieces is clearly winning. This kind of game is not very nun-like.
column2: 这张桌上摆着一局简单骰子戏的棋子。执红子的一方显然要赢了。这种游戏不太像修女会玩的。

column1: This wastebin is full of discarded vegetable peels. Perhaps they save them for something?
column2: 这只废物箱里满是丢掉的菜皮。也许她们留着有什么用？

column1: A clutch of harpies springs out from their roost in the cliffs, and before anyone can react, they have completely surrounded Bato.
column2: 一群哈比从崖壁上的巢里扑出来，谁都来不及反应，它们已经把 Bato 团团围住。

column1: As quickly as you can, you send for help from your stronghold.
column2: 你尽快向据点求援。

column1: Far below, you can see the waves crashing against the base of the cliff in an angry froth.
column2: 远远的下方，能看见浪头愤怒地撞在崖底，溅起白沫。

column1: It is probably better that you don't.
column2: 你最好还是不要。

column1: It takes a few hours, but working together, you eventually manage to get the two of them back up to the top of the cliff.
column2: 花了几个小时，但大家合力，最终还是把他们两个弄回了崖顶。

column1: One of the harpies latches onto Bato and pulls him, flailing and screaming over the edge of the cliff!
column2: 一只哈比扑住 Bato，把他连扑腾带尖叫地拽下了悬崖边！

column1: The initials "N G" are written.
column2: 上面写着姓名首字母“N G”。

column1: The initials "T W" are written.
column2: 上面写着姓名首字母“T W”。

column1: The thought of jumping occurs to you suddenly, almost desperately.
column2: 跳下去的念头突然冒出来，几乎是不顾一切的。

column1: Beauregard and Grant appear to be getting along today better than usual. You decide not to draw attention to it so as not to spoil the peaceful moment.
column2: Beauregard 和 Grant 今天似乎相处得比平时好。你决定不点破，免得破坏这片刻的平静。

column1: Beauregard takes a deep draught of the warm night air and turns his gaze to the sky.
column2: Beauregard 深深吸了一口温暖的夜气，目光转向天空。

column1: In the morning, you awaken to a mouth-watering smell, as heavy slabs of fresh venison roast over a pit of open coals.
column2: 早晨，你被一阵令人垂涎的气味唤醒，大块新鲜鹿肉正在一坑明炭上烤着。

column1: This weather-worn satchel is almost impossible to see amid the greenery. You find a dirty bundle of coins inside.
column2: 这只被风雨磨蚀的挎包几乎隐在绿叶里，很难看见。你在里面找到一包脏污的钱币。

column1: With a hearty breakfast in your belly and a bright morning sun lighting the way, you're able to get back to the path with little difficulty.
column2: 肚子里有一顿扎实的早餐，明亮的朝阳照着路，你没费什么劲就回到了小路上。

column1: Your party settles into the old shack for the night, and you quickly succumb to the embrace of your bedroll.
column2: 你的队伍在这间旧棚屋里安顿过夜，你很快就陷进了铺盖的怀抱。

column1: A voice like a shrill hiss calls out, "Turn back!"
column2: 一个尖利如嘶嘶声的声音喊道：“回去！”

column1: As if in warning, a darkness descends over you, snuffing out your torch.
column2: 仿佛是警告，黑暗压下来，掐灭了你的火把。

column1: It reads : The Jackals know.
column2: 上面写着：胡狼知道。

column1: Someone has scrawled something on the base of this statue in a shaky hand.
column2: 有人用颤抖的笔迹在这座雕像的底座上涂了些什么。

column1: The darkness of the tomb coalesces into a savage form and attacks you!
column2: 墓里的黑暗凝成一个凶蛮的形体，向你攻来！

column1: An old chest, sealed tight with weather and age.
column2: 一只旧箱子，被风雨和岁月封得死死的。

column1: It feels a bit petty, but you scrape up a handful of coins from the well. They're perfectly workable.
column2: 这么做有点小气，可你还是从井里抠出一把钱币。它们完全能用。

column1: It is difficult to get a decent grip on the lid to force it. Perhaps another attempt will open it.
column2: 很难抓牢箱盖把它撬开。也许再试一次能打开。

column1: It looks as though someone carrying a lot of goods was attacked and left for dead here. Most of the rubble has been picked-over, but there is one heavily-damaged chest that is still sealed.
column2: 看来有个带着大量货物的人在这里遭了袭击，被弃下等死。大部分残骸都被翻过了，但还有一只损坏严重的箱子仍然封着。

column1: It looks as though someone made a hasty attempt to hide this satchel. It has a few items inside.
column2: 看来有人曾匆忙想把这只挎包藏起来。里面有几件东西。

column1: It takes a bit of creative leverage, but you manage to pop the lid off of the sealed chest.
column2: 费了点巧劲借力，你还是把那只封死的箱子盖撬开了。

column1: It's just full of stagnant rainwater, filmed over with scum and wriggling bug larvae.
column2: 里面不过是一汪死寂的雨水，水面覆着一层浮渣，还有扭动的虫子幼虫。

column1: The lock is old and quite seized. This may take another attempt.
column2: 这把锁又旧又卡死。可能还得再试一次。

column1: There are coins glittering in the bottom of the well.
column2: 井底有钱币在闪光。

column1: This well is overflowing with cool, clear water. It appears to be built on some kind of natural spring.
column2: 这口井满溢着清凉的清水。看来是建在某种天然泉眼上。

column1: With a mighty heave, the lid gives way and slides onto the ground.
column2: 你猛力一掀，箱盖松脱，滑到了地上。

column1: Would you like to throw some coins into the well?
column2: 要把一些钱币扔进井里吗？

column1: You throw a handful of coins into the clear water and watch as they tumble to the bottom, glittering on the way down. For a moment, there is a comfortable feeling. Maybe you'll get lucky!
column2: 你把一把钱币扔进清水，看着它们翻滚着沉下去，一路闪着光。有那么一瞬，心里觉得踏实。也许你会走运！

column1: A moment later you are jarred awake as you are slammed into a rocky outcropping. You drag yourself out of the water, but you are a long distance from where you started.
column2: 片刻之后，你猛地撞上一处突出的岩石，被震醒。你把自己拖出水面，但离出发的地方已经很远。

column1: A warm breeze blows through the inlet, and the empty mantis husks dissolve into dust, drifting on the wind.
column2: 一阵暖风吹过水湾，空空的螳螂壳化成尘土，随风飘散。

column1: From here, you can see that there is an inlet with something peculiar at its end. It looks like the current would carry you directly into it if you let it.
column2: 从这里能看见一处水湾，尽头有些古怪的东西。看样子只要你随它去，水流就会把你直接送进去。

column1: It is a difficult swim, but you manage to push through it and climb onto the opposite bank.
column2: 这段很难游，可你还是游了过去，爬上了对岸。

column1: It looks like there used to be a pier on the opposite bank, but the river has since washed it away. There would be no way for you to climb out of the water if you swam over.
column2: 对岸从前似乎有一座码头，后来被河水冲走了。你要是游过去，就没法从水里爬上来。

column1: It takes everything you've got, but you manage to keep apace and make it to the opposite shore.
column2: 你拼尽了所有力气，但还是跟上了水流，到了对岸。

column1: Not until the party has been reunited.
column2: 要等队伍重聚才行。

column1: Not until the party is reuinted.
column2: 要等队伍重聚才行。

column1: One of these papers has a drawing of the layout of this area on it. Apparently someone was planning on rebuilding the bridges, but the paper is so old and worn that you doubt whoever drew this is going to return.
column2: 其中一张纸上画着这一带的布局。显然曾有人打算重修这些桥，可纸又旧又破，你怀疑画它的人不会再回来。

column1: Swimming across one by one is too risky. There must be a way to make crossing easier.
column2: 一个一个游过去风险太大。一定有办法让渡河容易些。

column1: The current is stronger than you expect. You're dashed against the rocks and manage to climb to shore a short distance downstream.
column2: 水流比你预料的更急。你被冲到岩石上，设法在下游不远处爬上了岸。

column1: The current is stronger than you expect. You're dashed against the rocks, but manage to climb to shore a short distance downstream.
column2: 水流比你预料的更急。你被冲到岩石上，但还是在下游不远处爬上了岸。

column1: The powerful current drags you under, and you are swept away.
column2: 汹涌的水流把你拖进水下，你被冲走了。

column1: The water looks rough, but if you swim across, you might be able to find a way to help the others follow.
column2: 水面看着很凶，可你要是游过去，也许能找到办法帮其他人跟上来。

column1: The wind has moved on, and the inlet is once again still and quiet.
column2: 风已经过去，水湾重又静了下来。

column1: There are dead mantis husks clinging to this statue. For whatever reason, they haven't been picked off by birds or other predators.
column2: 有死螳螂的空壳扒在这座雕像上。不知为什么，鸟和其他猎食者都没有把它们叼走。

column1: There is nothing in the sack but a few stones. Apparently it was set here as bait for an ambush.
column2: 麻袋里除了几块石头什么都没有。显然是放在这里，当埋伏的诱饵。

column1: These barrels don't have anything in them, but they still seem to be watertight. They would probably float.
column2: 这些桶里什么都没有，可看起来仍然不漏水。它们大概浮得起来。

column1: This gap is much wider than the others. It's going to take a very strong swimmer to make it across.
column2: 这道缺口比其他的宽得多。得水性极好才能游过去。

column1: Though it's hardly easy, the barrels lodged in the rocks make crossing the river on foot doable. It takes a few minutes, but you get everybody safely across.
column2: 虽然一点也不轻松，卡在岩石间的桶让徒步过河变得可行。花了几分钟，你让所有人都安全过去了。

column1: Using the lodged barrels as footholds, you're able to cross the water with relative ease.
column2: 借着卡住的桶当落脚点，你相对轻松地过了水。

column1: Would you like to cross to the opposite bank?
column2: 要渡到对岸吗？

column1: You are dashed against the rocks and thrown onto a bank a short distance downstream. Your party makes their way back to you and pulls you out of the muck.
column2: 你被冲到岩石上，甩到下游不远处的岸边。你的队伍折返回来，把你从泥里拉出来。

column1: You are reminded of the chunk of slag you are carrying. Make an offering of the Mantis Soul?
column2: 你想起了身上带着的那块熔渣。要献上螳螂之魂吗？

column1: You could jump into the water from here and try to swim to the opposite pier, but the rock you are standing on is far too high to climb back onto.
column2: 你可以从这里跳进水里，试着游向对面的码头，可你脚下这块岩石太高，爬不回去。

column1: You let the current carry you into the inlet, and climb onto a low rock.
column2: 你任由水流把你带进水湾，爬上一块低矮的岩石。

column1: You push the empty barrels into the water, and they float downstream.
column2: 你把空桶推进水里，它们顺流漂走了。

column1: You swim to the pier, and your party makes it back in time to help you out of the water.
column2: 你游到码头，队伍及时赶回来，帮你出了水。

column1: I think I just juiced in my shorts a little. Would you say treasure" a few more times for me, Captain? A little deeper and slower, please."
column2: “我好像刚在短裤里射出来一点。你能不能把“宝物”再为我多说几遍吗，船长？请再深一点，再慢一点。”

column1: Bato sneers up at Rangda and puffs out his chest.
column2: Bato 抬头朝 Rangda 冷笑，还把胸膛挺了起来。

column1: Inside is a magnificent sword, clearly meant for someone of much importance. It seems that Captain Arris' sword is now yours.
column2: 里面是一柄华美的剑，显然是给身份显赫的人用的。看来 Arris 船长的剑现在归你了。

column1: It looks as though this machine has been torn apart for salvage.
column2: 看来这台机器已被拆开，零件被人取走了。

column1: It looks as though this manacannon is still functional. If you loaded a cannonball into the barrel, you could fire it.
column2: 这门魔力炮看起来还能用。你要是把炮弹装填进炮管，就可以发射。

column1: Looks like that one shot was all you get.
column2: 看来就这一发了。

column1: Someone has made an attempt to hide something by covering it with an old sack.
column2: 有人试图用一只旧麻袋盖住什么东西，把它藏起来。

column1: The chain on this winch stretches down into the depths, and the handle gives firm resistance. It appears to be attached to something.
column2: 这台绞盘的链条一直伸进深处，摇柄的阻力很实。看来下面拴着东西。

column1: The handle and the footing beneath are both slippery. Perhaps another attempt would fare better.
column2: 摇柄和脚下都湿滑。也许再试一次会好一些。

column1: The manacannon is loaded and ready to fire. Do you want to fire it?
column2: 魔力炮已经装填，可以发射。要发射吗？

column1: There are still a few items left inside this discarded satchel.
column2: 这只被丢下的挎包里还剩几件东西。

column1: There is a cannonball inside one of these barrels.
column2: 其中一只桶里有一枚炮弹。

column1: There is nothing of interest inside the barrels.
column2: 桶里没有什么值得注意的东西。

column1: This chest is secured with a custom lock. You'll need to get the proper key.
column2: 这只箱子用一把特制的锁锁着。你得弄到对应的钥匙。

column1: This console does not appear to be functional.
column2: 这个控制台看起来无法使用。

column1: This is a manacannon barrel, but it appears to be broken.
column2: 这是一根魔力炮炮管，可看起来已经坏了。

column1: This manacannon is loaded and ready to fire.
column2: 这门魔力炮已经装填，可以发射。

column1: This manacannon looks functional, but it is not loaded. If you had a cannonball, you could load it here.
column2: 这门魔力炮看着还能用，但没有装填。你要是有炮弹，可以在这里装填。

column1: This node appears to still have some power left in it.
column2: 这个节点似乎还剩一些能量。

column1: Would you like to load the manacannon?
column2: 要给魔力炮装填吗？

column1: You are able to levitate a cannonball out of one of the barrels.
column2: 你把一枚炮弹从其中一只桶里浮了出来。

column1: You load your cannonball into the barrel.
column2: 你把炮弹装填进炮管。

column1: You use the key you found on Captain Arris, and the lock pops open with ease.
column2: 你用从 Arris 船长身上找到的钥匙，锁轻易地弹开了。

column1: You wind the chain up, and there is a heavy wooden chest hooked to the other end!
column2: 你把链条绞上来，另一头挂着一只沉重的木箱！

column1: As his story draws to a close, he turns his face back to the sea, and you catch a glimpse of a brand on his neck. \n"Traitor"
column2: 故事将近尾声，他把脸转回大海，你瞥见他脖子上的烙印。\n“叛徒”

column1: Logus goes on at length with a tale of a seafaring adventure. It is obvious from his story that he is an experienced sailor, and he speaks with great fondness and longing.
column2: Logus 把一段航海冒险讲了很久。从故事里显然看得出他是个老练的水手，说起来满是眷恋和向往。

column1: Logus scratches his beard thoughtfully, the edge of a grin beginning to form.
column2: Logus 若有所思地挠着胡子，一丝笑意开始浮出来。

column1: Logus stands up and takes a deep breath of sea air before pulling his hat low over his eyes and flashing you a scoundrel's grin.
column2: Logus 站起身，深深吸了一口海上的空气，然后把帽子压低遮住眼睛，朝你闪过一个无赖的笑。

column1: Logus turns toward you with intense eyes. He runs his tongue against one of his tusks as he sizes you up before finally speaking.
column2: Logus 转向你，眼神锐利。他用舌头抵着一颗獠牙打量你，最后才开口。

column1: Sitting here, staring out over the grey sea is a weathered old orc, dressed in the tatters of a sea captain's uniform. As you approach, he glances up toward you.
column2: 一个饱经风霜的老兽人坐在这里，望着灰色的海，穿着一身破烂的船长制服。你走近时，他抬眼瞥向你。

column1: The herbalist mixes a potion for you.
column2: 草药师为你调了一瓶药水。

column1: There is a sturdy length of rope tied to this mooring. The sailor's knot is easily undone, and you are able to coil up a decent amount of rope.
column2: 这根系船柱上拴着一截结实的绳子。水手结很容易解开，你卷起了相当长的一截绳子。

column1: This chest is fastened securely with a unique lock. You'll need the key.
column2: 这只箱子用一把独特的锁锁得严实。你需要钥匙。

column1: And so, you can remain civil even in the face of that which must surely shock you? Intriguing.
column2: 如此说来，面对那必定令你震惊之物，你仍能保持礼数？有意思。

column1: And you are so bold as to say it before me, even knowing nothing of my power?
column2: 你竟大胆到当着我的面说出来，甚至对我的力量一无所知？

column1: But no matter. The test to prove your worth is long past, and your reward is nigh. Behold!
column2: 不过无妨。证明你价值的考验早已过去，奖赏近在眼前。看啊！

column1: I give you the bow that wounded the sun.
column2: 我把伤过太阳的那张弓赐给你。

column1: Now, stay and avail yourself of my hospitality for as long as it pleases you.
column2: 现在，留下吧。尽可享用我的款待，直到你不再乐意。

column1: Tell me, hero. Does the sight of my court disgust you?
column2: 告诉我，英雄。我宫廷的景象，可让你厌恶？

column1: The water whispered to me of your coming. This island has long been a place of madness, but you come to impose your order.
column2: 水低声向我诉说你的到来。这座岛长久以来是一处疯狂之地，而你是来把你的秩序加在这里的。

column1: This table is laid out with a mouthwatering display.
column2: 这张桌上摆着令人垂涎的一席。

column1: Welcome. Avail yourself of my food and drink if it pleases you.
column2: 欢迎。若你乐意，请随意享用我的饮食。

column1: You decide against it.
column2: 你决定不这么做。

column1: A patch of plump mushrooms sprouts here. This variety is known to be edible, if foul-tasting.
column2: 这里长着一片肥硕的蘑菇。这种据说可以吃，只是味道恶劣。

column1: Inside the mouldering barrel, you find a torch that seems dry enough to use.
column2: 在这只霉烂的桶里，你找到一支看着还够干、能用的火把。

column1: This chest has been weakened by years of moisture and neglect. You find a handful of coins inside.
column2: 这只箱子被多年的潮湿和弃置蚀软了。你在里面找到一把钱币。

column1: This chest smells strongly of wine. Although most of it has broken and soaked into the wood, you find an unopened phial in the corner.
column2: 这只箱子酒味很冲。虽然大部分都碎了，渗进木头里，你还是在角落找到一只未开封的小瓶。

column1: This signboard has the layout for the tunnel scrawled on it.
column2: 这块告示板上涂着隧道的布局。

column1: I can't believe I scored the Breakfast suite! This is gonna be great! They send someone to wake you up in the morning, and you know what that means!
column2: “我简直不敢相信我搞到了早餐套房！这下可美了！他们早上会派人来叫醒你，你知道那意味着什么！”

column1: I don't think I would classify those looks I am getting as overcome with animal desire", would you? I can't even remember the last time I dug a rut."
column2: “我不觉得我会把现在这些看我的眼神归为“被兽欲冲昏了头”，对吧？我都记不清上次发情干过是什么时候了。”

column1: I guess I'll just keep my fingers crossed. Odds are I'll get one of the ladies anyway, right?
column2: “我想我就指望运气吧。反正多半会分到一位姑娘，对吧？”

column1: I heard that they share product" with the Ettins in order to get them to stand guard like that. Which unlucky girl do you think gets that job?"
column2: “我听说他们跟那些双头巨人“分享货色”，好让他们那样站岗。你觉得哪个倒霉的姑娘会摊上这差事？”

column1: It would probably be weird having someone without any tusks doing that anyway, wouldn't it? Ugh, why am I stuck between toothless human girls or orcs with beards?
column2: “反正让一个没长獠牙的人来干那事，大概也会很怪，对吧？呃，我怎么卡在没牙的人类姑娘和长胡子的兽人之间？”

column1: Of course, now I'm not going to be able to sleep. At least they have lots of books.
column2: “当然，这下我睡不着了。好在他们书很多。”

column1: What am I gonna do if he's the room service"?"
column2: “要是他就是那个“客房服务”，我该怎么办？”

column1: After a loud and satisfying half-hour, Leftie wipes himself off with a wadded-up bedsheet and stands up.
column2: 喧闹而尽兴的半小时过后，Leftie 用一团揉皱的床单把自己擦干净，站起身来。

column1: At first he seems like he is going to argue, but then his voice pours out of him with an audible note of relief.
column2: 起初他像是要争辩，随后话却从他嘴里涌出来，听得出如释重负。

column1: By the sounds of things, she's currently busy.
column2: 听那动静，她这会儿正忙着。

column1: Give your spool of wire to Braisa?
column2: 把你的那卷金属丝交给 Braisa？

column1: He is ample and forceful enough to be exciting, even if his technique is somewhat basic.
column2: 他分量足、力道也够，足以让人兴奋，尽管技巧相当基础。

column1: He laughs, apparently thinking that your compliment was sarcastic.
column2: 他笑了，显然以为你的夸奖是在讽刺。

column2: 他注意到你在打量他，重重叹了口气。

column1: It is clear that he has little if any experience being intimate with other men, but he doesn't back down, and takes his cues from you attentively.
column2: 看得出他跟其他男人亲热几乎毫无经验，可他没有退缩，并且留心跟着你的引导。

column1: It sounds like an intimate moment. You'd best leave them to it.
column2: 听着像是亲热的时刻。你最好别去打扰他们。

column1: Leftie is not a graceful lover, but he eagerly does what is expected, and follows through on your deal.
column2: Leftie 当情人并不优雅，可他热切地做了该做的事，也把你们的交易履行到底。

column1: Leftie takes in a deep breath, and a dour smile creeps across his lips.
column2: Leftie 深深吸了口气，一丝阴郁的笑爬上嘴唇。

column1: Logus' face flushes, and he abruptly stops with his inquiry.
column2: Logus 的脸红了，他突然停住，不再追问。

column1: Mailee slowly disrobes and then removes your clothes as well.
column2: Mailee 慢慢脱掉衣服，接着也脱掉了你的。

column2: Mailee 的手柔软如丝绒，她用娴熟的手法让手指在你身上游走。

column1: Rugal is not courteous, but he is powerful, ferocious, and relentless.
column2: Rugal 并不体贴，可他有力、凶猛，而且毫不停歇。

column1: Rugal wastes no time with pleasantries and gets straight to business.
column2: Rugal 不浪费时间客套，直接办正事。

column1: Shapiro laughs.
column2: Shapiro 笑了。

column1: That sounds like a private conversation.

column2: 这个巨大的男人说话机械，台词像是背熟的。他明明有足以吓人的身量，却一点也不费那个劲。

column2: 那个双头巨人正紧盯着你，显然在当守卫。

column2: 有个男人正在仔细检查这里的墙。

column1: A wave of heat blasts through the opening. Nikolai throws up his hands and shouts a barrier into being in front of him, but his body shudders heavily from the effort.
column2: 一股热浪从开口轰然冲过。Nikolai 举起双手，大喝一声，在身前唤出一道屏障，可他的身体因这番用力而剧烈颤抖。

column1: It might be possible to use Nikolai's Emblem to remove the wall here, but it would take a strong surge of magical energy.
column2: 也许可以用 Nikolai 的徽记移除这里的墙，但那需要一股强大的魔力涌动。

column1: Nikolai gives you a soft smile. He is clearly exhausted and overcome.
column2: Nikolai 对你露出一个柔和的微笑。他显然已经精疲力竭，难以自持。

column1: Nikolai holds out the emblem and points it towards the wall. It begins to illuminate the area.
column2: Nikolai 举起徽记，朝墙指去。它开始照亮这一带。

column1: Nikolai stands frozen in fear, trying to catch his breath. He looks nearly ready to collapse.
column2: Nikolai 吓得僵在原地，竭力喘着气。他看上去几乎要倒下了。

column1: Nikolai steadily makes his way down the road.
column2: Nikolai 稳步沿路走去。

column1: Somebody who is proficient with magic may still be able to use the emblem by channeling their energy through it, however.
column2: 不过，精通魔力的人或许仍能把自身的能量引导穿过徽记来使用它。

column1: Still shaken from earlier events, Nikolai hobbles down the road. He apparently forgot to ask for his emblem back.
column2: Nikolai 仍因先前的事心有余悸，一瘸一拐地沿路走去。他显然忘了把徽记要回去。

column1: The chest is outlined with a silver trim, and decorated with strange runes. There are a couple of bottles of liquor stashed inside.
column2: 这口箱子镶着银边，饰有奇怪的符文。里面藏着一两瓶酒。

column1: The emblem glows for a moment, but suddenly fades. It seems to be tapped of magical energy after its last use.
column2: 徽记亮了一瞬，却突然黯淡下去。经过上一次使用，它的魔力似乎已经耗尽。

column1: The old priest holds out his hand tentatively, and you give him the emblem.
column2: 老牧师迟疑地伸出手，你把徽记交给他。

column1: The staircase leads down a long way. Most of it is hidden by the darkness, but you can see two flickering lights illuminating the bottom few steps.
column2: 楼梯向下延伸很长一段。大部分隐在黑暗中，但你能看见两盏摇曳的灯光照着最底下的几级台阶。

column1: Thin trails of smoke billow off from the candles around the magic circle, as if they had recently been extinguished.
column2: 魔法阵周围的蜡烛冒出细细的烟缕，仿佛刚刚被熄灭。

column1: This looks like a comfortable place to take a nap, but now is perhaps not the time.

column2: 这段墙的形状不同寻常，上面布满奇怪的蚀刻。

column1: This wall looks similar to the one Nikolai opened. It even has the same kinds of markings etched into it.

column1: You hold out the emblem and point it towards the wall.

column1: You suddenly realize that the temperature inside this room is stiflingly warm.

column1: You take a moment to explain what happened. Nikolai's face gradually becomes wracked with sadness and guilt. He turns away for a moment, his breathing laboured and heavy, but trying his best to maintain his composure.
column2: 你花了一点时间说明发生了什么。Nikolai 的脸上渐渐写满悲伤与愧疚。他转过身去片刻，呼吸沉重而吃力，却竭力保持镇定。

column1: Amongst the empty bottles on the desk are one or two finished potions.

column2: 你进来的那扇门有单向锁定机关，从这一侧打不开。

column1: The main compartment is stuffed with textbooks, but there is a gold ring inside the front pocket. It might come in useful.

column1: The owner of this satchel is nowhere to be seen. Would you like to peek inside?

column2: 卷轴的光辉消退，它皱缩着落到地板上。

column2: “这个 Leviathan 是「我们命运的嫉妒之主」，书上这么说。他……是这座岛上活着的一部分，生死、繁荣或苦难，全凭他一时兴起。这未免太阴郁了，不是吗？”

column1: There is a key tucked into the top drawer here.
column2: 这里的顶层抽屉里塞着一把钥匙。

column1: There is a note on this table. It reads, "Make sure that you check the refugees. If any of them got ahold of a key, we could have a break in quarantine, and I don't need to tell you how bad that would be."
column2: 这张桌子上有一张便条。上面写着：“务必检查那些难民。要是他们当中有谁弄到了钥匙，隔离就可能被冲破，那会有多糟，不用我告诉你。”

column1: This figure makes no motion to attack, and when you approach, the head he holds in his outstretched hand begins to speak.
column2: 这个人影没有做出攻击的动作。你走近时，他伸出的手里捧着的那颗头开始说话。

column1: This sign post is ancient. It reads, "Quarantine Zone".
column2: 这根路牌很古老。上面写着：“隔离区”。

column1: After a few turns, the water becomes deeper, and the current gentler. You can no longer reach the floor, so you let the water carry you onward.
column2: 转过几个弯后，水变深了，水流也更缓。你再也够不着底，于是任由水把你往前带。

column1: As quietly as possible, you begin teasing the boards apart, hiding each one underneath the bed as you go.
column2: 你尽可能安静地开始把木板一块块撬开，边撬边把每块藏到床底下。

column1: At their head is a woman, strikingly beautiful but for a severely discoloured front tooth.
column2: 为首的是一个女人，美得惊人，只是一颗门牙严重变色。

column1: Being mindful to check on the guards regularly, you eventually clear a way into the adjacent cell.
column2: 你留心不时查看守卫，最终清出一条通往相邻牢房的路。

column1: Go down the ladder?
column2: 要下梯子吗？

column1: It looks as if it could simply be pulled down, with some effort.
column2: 看上去只要费些力气，就能把它拉下来。

column1: Next to the papers is a slightly rusted copper key. You decide to take it with you.
column2: 纸张旁边有一把略微生锈的铜钥匙。你决定把它带走。

column1: One of the boards snaps in half, and gives you a nasty splinter.
column2: 有一块木板从中折断，狠狠扎了你一根刺。

column1: Something hard strikes the side of your head, and your body goes limp.
column2: 有什么硬东西砸中你的头侧，你的身体瘫软下去。

column1: Soon, you see a faint light coming from up ahead. As you float closer, you see another jetty, jutting out into the flow. You grab hold of it as you float closer and haul yourself out of the drink.
column2: 不久，你看见前方有一点微光。你漂近时，看见另一座栈桥伸进水流。你漂近时抓住它，把自己从水里拖上来。

column1: The air coming from below is quite chilly, but feels refreshing.\nYou can hear the sound of rushing water.
column2: 下面涌来的空气相当阴冷，却令人神清气爽。\n你能听见湍急的水声。

column1: The band of ruffians begin rifling through your pockets.
column2: 这伙流氓团伙开始翻你的口袋。

column1: The chest is empty.
column2: 箱子是空的。

column1: The water is not very deep, but it is very cold, and the tunnel quickly grows dark as the current pushes you away from the torchlit jetty.
column2: 水不算很深，却非常冷。水流把你推离火把照亮的栈桥，隧道很快暗了下来。

column1: The water looks clean, and does not seem particularly deep. You could climb in and let the current carry you downstream, but there is no telling where you might end up.
column2: 水看上去很干净，似乎也不特别深。你可以爬进去，让水流把你带向下游，但说不准你会到哪里。

column1: There is a small stack of papers on the table. You flick through a few shets, but there is nothing that jumps out as being important.
column2: 桌上有一小叠纸。你翻了几页，但没有什么显得重要的东西。

column1: There is a tremendous scuffling, and in an instant, before you can reach for your weapons, you are completely surrounded by scruffy rogues.
column2: 一阵剧烈的骚动，转眼之间，你还没来得及去拿武器，就被一群邋遢的流氓团团围住。

column1: There's a small iron key hidden underneath the bed.
column2: 床底下藏着一把小铁钥匙。

column1: This looks like all the gold that was stolen from you.
column2: 这些看上去就是从你身上偷走的全部金币。

column1: This section of wall is boarded up.
column2: 这段墙用木板封死了。

column1: This tree looks significantly less healthy than the others.\nThe ground around it is cracked and uneven, and many of its roots are sticking out above ground, as if it had been previously uprooted and put back.
column2: 这棵树看上去比其他树不健康得多。\n它周围的地面开裂不平，许多树根突出地面，仿佛它先前曾被连根拔起，又被放了回去。

column1: Water flows underneath the jetty at a brisk speed. You notice some pieces of weathered rope tied to some of the posts, suggesting that something is usually moored here.
column2: 水在栈桥下以很快的速度流过。你注意到几段风化的绳子系在一些桩上，说明这里通常停着什么。

column1: Whoever worked on this has done a sloppy job. Some of the boards look wobbly and loose. You could probably just smash through, or if you're nimble enough, you might be able to pry them open quietly.
column2: 做这活的人干得很马虎。有些木板看着摇摇晃晃、松松垮垮。你大概可以直接砸穿，或者你若足够灵巧，也许能悄悄把它们撬开。

column1: With a mighty shove, the tree topples over to the side,\nrevealing a hidden door.
column2: 你猛力一推，树向一侧倒下，\n露出一扇隐藏的门。

column1: With no regard for your own safety, you smash through the wall.
column2: 你不顾自身安危，砸穿了这堵墙。

column1: You are numb and shivering, but back on solid ground once more. With any luck, a campfire will be forthcoming.
column2: 你浑身麻木，瑟瑟发抖，但总算重新站上了实地。运气好的话，很快就会有一堆营火。

column1: You decide to step back from the edge. Jumping in seems needlessly risky.
column2: 你决定从边缘退开。跳下去似乎是在冒毫无必要的风险。

column1: You gently lower yourself off the edge and into the water.
column2: 你轻轻从边缘放下自己，进入水中。

column1: You hear a clicking noise, but nothing happens.
column2: 你听见一声咔哒，但什么也没发生。

column1: It reads : If not ye guardian be, turn back.
column2: 上面写着：若汝非守护者，回头吧。

column1: The pedestal is covered with snails and barnacles. There is something written on the very top.
column2: 基座上爬满蜗牛和藤壶。最顶上写着什么。

column1: At the bottom, however, you notice a raised, circular section of wood which looks somewhat like a large button. It has the shape of a jewel carved into it.
column2: 不过在底部，你注意到一块凸起的圆形木头，有点像一颗大按钮。上面刻着一颗宝石的形状。

column1: Climb down the stairway?
column2: 要沿楼梯爬下去吗？

column1: Crisp and sweet, with just the right amount of sourness. Truly, you have never tasted a better pickle.
column2: 清脆香甜，酸度刚刚好。真的，你从未尝过比这更好的酸黄瓜。

column1: It's delicious! The combination of spices is out of this world. If only there was some warm, honey glazed ham here, too.
column2: 好吃极了！香料的搭配妙不可言。要是这儿再有一块温热的蜜汁火腿就好了。

column1: It's time to get a move on. You can't just stand around eating pickles all day.
column2: 该动身了。你不能整天站在这儿吃酸黄瓜。

column1: Old, dusty books are scattered across this part of the table.
column2: 这片桌面上散落着陈旧、落满灰尘的书。

column1: One of the larger books is inlaid with a green jewel, and looks quite heavy--at least a thousand pages long.
column2: 其中一本较大的书镶着一颗绿宝石，看着相当重——至少有一千页。

column1: One of the larger books is inlaid with a green jewel, and looks quite heavy--at least a thousand pages long. The shape in which the jewel has been cut looks familiar...
column2: 其中一本较大的书镶着一颗绿宝石，看着相当重——至少有一千页。宝石切割的形状看着眼熟……

column1: Place the encyclopedia in the chest?
column2: 要把百科全书放进箱子里吗？

column1: Putting one foot on the first step to make sure it is not an illusion, you carefully begin your descent--one step at a time.
column2: 你把一只脚踩上第一级台阶，确认这不是幻象，然后小心地开始下行——一次一级。

column1: The book is sealed shut, as if the pages have been glued together.
column2: 这本书封死了，仿佛书页被粘在了一起。

column1: The chest's lid tries to close on your arm! You remove your arm from the chest, and the lid falls back open. There is another click, and the button returns to its original position.
column2: 箱盖试图夹住你的手臂！你把胳膊从箱子里抽出来，箱盖又落回打开的状态。又是一声咔哒，按钮回到原来的位置。

column1: The crystal doesn't react when you touch it.
column2: 你触摸这颗水晶时，它没有反应。

column1: The encyclopedia fits snugly inside the chest. It starts to sink as its weight pushes down on the button.
column2: 百科全书严丝合缝地放进箱子里。它的重量压上按钮，开始往下沉。

column1: The steps near the top are beginning to fade. It would be unwise to try climbing back up.
column2: 靠近顶部的台阶开始消逝。试图爬回去是不明智的。

column1: This cauldron is filled with pickled vegetables. The smell coming off it tempts your tastebuds, but you are unsure how long these have been sitting here.
column2: 这口大锅里装满了腌菜。飘出的气味诱惑着你的味蕾，但你不确定这些东西在这儿放了多久。

column1: This plant looks a little withered. You see signs of intentional damage near the base of the pot--there is a small fracture where soil has spilled out.
column2: 这株植物看着有些枯萎。你看见花盆底部附近有故意损坏的痕迹——有一道小裂缝，泥土从那里漏了出来。

column1: Which pickle will you try this time?
column2: 这次你要尝哪一种酸黄瓜？

column1: With some effort, you press down on the wooden disk until it is level with the bottom of the chest. A faint click is heard.
column2: 你费了些力气，把这块木圆盘按到与箱底齐平。听见一声微弱的咔哒。

column1: Would you like to read some of it?
column2: 你想读一读其中一些吗？

column1: Would you like to take the book with you?
column2: 你想把这本书带走吗？

column1: Would you like to try one?
column2: 你想尝一个吗？

column1: Would you like to try pressing it?
column2: 你想试试按它吗？

column1: You hear a strange, mechanical noise from above.
column2: 你听见上方传来一阵奇怪的机械声。

column1: You slide the book near the table's edge, and carefully heft it into your arms.
column2: 你把书滑到桌边，小心地把它抱进怀里。

column1: You take a closer look, and see a keyring with two keys hidden underneath.
column2: 你凑近一看，看见下面藏着一只钥匙圈，上面有两把钥匙。

column1: You take one of the pickled cucumbers. The taste is surprisingly sweet and delicate, with a perfect crunch.
column2: 你拿起一根酸黄瓜。味道出奇地甜而细腻，脆得恰到好处。

column1: Your toes and hands tingle as you look down the stairway. It extends quite a distance, into unfamiliar land.
column2: 你俯视楼梯，脚趾和双手发麻。它延伸出相当长的距离，通向陌生的土地。

column1: This appears to be a signal fire meant to be viewed at a great distance.
column2: 这看上去是一堆供远距离观看的信号火。

column1: This corpse has been thoroughly chewed-on by wild animals. There is a small ring among the bones.
column2: 这具尸体被野兽彻底啃过。骨头中间有一枚小戒指。

column1: This sack seems to be full of foodstuffs. It seems as if this campsite was hastily-abandoned.
column2: 这只袋子里似乎装满了食物。这处营地仿佛是仓促遗弃的。

column1: Nope.
column2: 没有。

column1: You find a glimmer of something at the bottom of the... wait, no, that was just the lights playing tricks.
column2: 你在……的底部发现一点闪光。等等，不，那只是灯光在捉弄人。

column1: You peer into the chest, looking to find something that was missed by the previous looter. Nothing was found.
column2: 你朝箱子里张望，想找先前那个搜刮者漏掉的东西。什么也没找到。

column1: You take another look, hoping that this time you'll find something. No such luck.
column2: 你又看了一眼，希望这次能找到什么。没那运气。

column1: It reads : Make a offering of perfection to Lord Magister Josiah.
column2: 上面写着：向领主魔导师 Josiah 献上一份完美的祭品。

column1: The pedestal is stained brown with ancient blood. There is an inscription on the very top.
column2: 基座被古老的血迹染成褐色。最顶上有一段铭文。

column1: After a brief moment, he struggles to stand, his legs shaking under his own weight, and his eyes find yours.
column2: 片刻之后，他挣扎着站起来，双腿在自身的重量下发颤，目光找到了你。

column1: As you approach, the fleshy pod ruptures, and the massive body of a demon topples out, naked and wet.
column2: 你走近时，那肉荚破裂，一具恶魔巨大的身躯赤裸而湿淋淋地倒了出来。

column1: He looks up once again, his voice more confident this time.
column2: 他再次抬起头，这一次声音更有自信。

column1: The demon looks down at his own body with amazement, touching his skin with his fingertips as if it is the first time he has seen it.
column2: 恶魔惊讶地低头看着自己的身体，用指尖触碰皮肤，仿佛这是他第一次看见它。

column1: The naked demon strides past you, still dripping. You watch him climb the ladder, and then he is gone.
column2: 赤裸的恶魔大步从你身边走过，身上还在滴水。你看着他爬上梯子，然后他就消失了。

column1: There is a journal on the table here.
column2: 这里的桌子上有一本日志。

column1: Will you allow the demon to leave?
column2: 你要放这恶魔离开吗？

column1: As you step through the doorway into the strange yet familiar room, the door locks behind you and a foreboding shiver runs down your spine. It'd be best to not return here.
column2: 你穿过门口，步入这间既陌生又熟悉的房间，门在身后锁上，一阵不祥的战栗顺着脊背而下。最好不要再回到这里。

column1: Etched into the bottom of the empty chest, you can make out the word: "Greed".
column2: 空箱子的底部刻着字，你能辨认出这个词：“贪婪”。

column1: From afar, the chapel appears to bright and reverent, but as you approach the entrance, the illusion peels away, revealing the malevolent structure you discovered prior.
column2: 从远处看，这座小教堂显得明亮而肃穆，可当你走近入口，幻象剥落，露出你先前发现的那座恶毒建筑。

column1: The chest is sealed. Is it even a chest at all, or just a stone slab?
column2: 箱子是封死的。它到底是一口箱子，还是只是一块石板？

column1: A tiny blade slices into your finger. The cut is minor, but it hits you much harder than it ought to. Probably poison.
column2: 一片细小的刀刃切进你的手指。伤口不大，你却觉得比应有的重得多。大概是毒。

column1: Sifting through the clutter on the end of the table, you spy a key sitting amid the books.
column2: 你在桌端的杂物里翻找，发现一把钥匙搁在书中间。

column1: This chest appears to be locked and protected with a basic trap.
column2: 这口箱子似乎上了锁，并设有一个简单的陷阱。

column1: This table is covered with books and various trinkets. You find nothing of particular note.
column2: 这张桌子上盖满了书和各种小玩意。你没发现什么特别值得注意的东西。

column1: You spy something glinting on the floor between the pillows. It appears that a key had slipped off the table and been left on the floor.
column2: 你看见枕头之间的地板上有什么东西在闪光。似乎有一把钥匙从桌上滑落，留在了地板上。

column1: After having your evening's meal, you lay down in one of them and quickly drift off to sleep.
column2: 吃过晚饭后，你在其中一张床上躺下，很快就沉入了睡眠。

column1: An unexpected storm has put an abrupt end to your marching, and you've been forced to take shelter.
column2: 一场意外的风暴骤然中断了你们的行军，你们被迫找地方躲避。

column1: At least Leftie is happy.
column2: 至少 Leftie 很高兴。

column1: He's obviously quite upset.
column2: 他显然相当不高兴。

column1: In the morning, the sun is bright and the sky is clear. Leftie is in the best mood you have ever seen him in, wide-eyed and eager to get on the road.
column2: 早晨，阳光灿烂，天空晴朗。Leftie 的心情是你见过最好的一次，睁大眼睛，急着上路。

column1: In the morning, the sun is bright and the sky is clear. You haven't slept that well in a long time.
column2: 早晨，阳光灿烂，天空晴朗。你很久没有睡得这么好了。

column1: In the morning, the sun is bright and the sky is clear. You slept a little too late, but you awoke comfortably tangled in Leftie's arms, and didn't want to wake him.
column2: 早晨，阳光灿烂，天空晴朗。你睡得稍晚了些，醒来时舒舒服服地缠在 Leftie 的怀里，不想叫醒他。

column1: Leftie crawls under the blanket and into the bed behind you, forcing you to the very edge.
column2: Leftie 钻进毯子，从你身后爬上床，把你挤到最边上。

column1: Leftie moves a little, and you feel his beard and his lips brush against the back of your neck, perhaps deliberately, as he whispers near your ear.
column2: Leftie 动了动，你感到他的胡须和嘴唇擦过你的后颈，也许是故意的，他在你耳边低语。

column1: Leftie seems in a good mood, and stands a little closer to you than he did yesterday.
column2: Leftie 似乎心情不错，站得比昨天离你更近一些。

column1: Leftie smiles at you appreciatively, and then crawls into the bed, pulling the blankets up around himself.
column2: Leftie 感激地对你笑了笑，然后爬上床，把毯子拉到自己身上。

column1: Leftie, however, looks haggard, and his mood is foul. He'll clearly be needing a long nap when you get back to the stronghold.
column2: Leftie 却看上去憔悴不堪，心情恶劣。等你们回到据点，他显然需要好好睡上一大觉。

column1: You are jolted awake as Leftie's bed gives out from beneath him and dumps him unceremoniously on the floor.
column2: 你被惊醒，Leftie 的床从他身下塌了，把他毫不客气地摔到地上。

column1: You bar the door and hang your things up to dry. The beds, though old, seem to be in good shape, and after shaking the dust out of the bedclothes, they promise a rare night of comfort.
column2: 你闩上门，把东西挂起来晾干。床虽然旧，看上去却还完好，把寝具上的灰抖掉之后，它们预示着难得的一夜安适。

column1: You barge in and look around nervously, but it seems that nobody is here, and for the time being at least, you're safe and out of the rain.
column2: 你闯进去，紧张地四下张望，但似乎没有人在，至少眼下你是安全的，也躲过了雨。

column1: You have a feeling it's going to be a good day.
column2: 你有一种感觉，今天会是好日子。

column1: You position yourself in front of the door and try to get as comfortable as you can. It looks like you're going to have a long night.
column2: 你在门前找了个位置，尽量让自己舒服些。看来你要熬一个长夜了。

column1: You sleepily settle back against his body, and after a long, indecisive moment, he gently drapes his heavy arm over you and pulls you against him.
column2: 你睡意朦胧地往后靠上他的身体，犹豫了许久之后，他轻轻把沉重的手臂搭到你身上，把你拉向他。

column1: You, however, have definitely felt better. Staying up all night in the storm was exhausting. Your back hurts, your feet hurt, and your head hurts too.
column2: 你却分明曾经好受得多。在风暴里熬了一整夜，累极了。你的背疼，脚疼，头也疼。

column1: It appears that both switches will have to be unlocked before the passage will open.
column2: 看来两处开关都得解开，通道才会打开。

column1: The Vampire laughs uproarously.
column2: 吸血鬼放声大笑。

column1: This heavy stone disc appears to be part of the locking mechanism for this passageway. There is a place to insert a key.
column2: 这块沉重的石盘似乎是这条通道锁定机关的一部分。上面有一个插入钥匙的地方。

column1: The explosion appears to have collapsed part of the cavern wall.
column2: 爆炸似乎震塌了洞窟墙壁的一部分。

column1: When you open this barrel, there is a sharp click of a device triggering, and the sharp odour of gunpowder. You drop the lid and scramble away from the kegs.
column2: 你打开这只桶时，机关触发，发出一声尖利的咔哒，还有刺鼻的火药味。你扔下盖子，连忙从那些桶边爬开。

column1: It's not all bad though, right? I mean, you've got some valuable stuff on you, and now that you're half-dead and I've already seen all your moves, well... I won't even break a sweat. Goodnight, Champions"."
column2: “不过也不全是坏事，对吧？我是说，你身上有些值钱的东西，而现在你已经半死不活，你的招式我也全看过了，嗯……我连汗都不用出。晚安，「冠军」们。”

column1: What is more important to you personally? Having a strong body, or a being well-known?
column2: “对你个人而言，什么更重要？拥有一副强壮的身体，还是声名远扬？”

column1: Freshen up before your next fight! Last chance!
column2: 下一场格斗前先休整一番！最后的机会！

column1: The chest appears to be locked, and trying to open it with the Arena Master standing right next to you would be quite rude.
column2: 这口箱子似乎上了锁，而竞技场主就站在你身旁，这时候想打开它可相当无礼。

column1: This area is dangerous, and can never be secured.
column2: 这一带很危险，而且永远无法肃清。

column1: You gather your party in the arena.
column2: 你把队伍召集到竞技场里。

column1: A gentle warmth now fills the cabin. It smells a little like cinnamon!
column2: 小屋里现在充满柔和的暖意。闻起来有点像肉桂！

column1: A large iron key is hidden inside the dresser drawer. Take it with you?
column2: 五斗柜抽屉里藏着一把大铁钥匙。要把它带走吗？

column1: The chest opens with no trouble.
column2: 箱子顺利打开了。

column1: The fireplace has been prepared with kindling and firewood. Would you like to light it?
column2: 壁炉里已经备好了引火物和木柴。你想把它点着吗？

column1: This canvas bag is ripped to pieces. You notice a couple of objects sticking out from the tattered mess.
column2: 这只帆布袋被撕成了碎片。你注意到有两三样东西从这堆破烂里戳出来。

column1: This tray is filled with a neat arrangement of cookies. You decide to swipe a few while nobody's looking...
column2: 这托盘上整齐地摆着饼干。你决定趁没人看见顺手拿走几块……

column1: You misjudge the momentum and speed required, and the cookies end up scattered all over the ground. They're fair game now.
column2: 你错估了所需的劲道和速度，饼干散了一地。现在它们谁都能拿了。

column1: You take a box of matches from on top of the nearby crate and ignite the kindling. Before long, you manage to get a good fire going.
column2: 你从旁边箱子顶上拿了一盒火柴，点着引火物。不久，你就生起了一堆好火。

column1: A few recently-discarded provisions remain in this sack.
column2: 这只袋子里还剩几样刚丢下不久的补给。

column1: There is nothing inside the chest. It wasn't locked or even properly latched.
column2: 箱子里什么也没有。它没上锁，甚至没有好好扣上。

column1: This satchel is full of coins, presumably coins the highwaymen stole from other travelers.
column2: 这只背包里装满了钱币，想必是拦路强盗从其他旅人身上偷来的。

column1: Grant wrinkles his nose in disgust.
column2: Grant 厌恶地皱起鼻子。

column1: He turns his head and spits on the floor, then adjusts his crotch, blatantly sizing you up.
column2: 他转过头，往地上吐了口唾沫，然后整了整裤裆，肆无忌惮地上下打量你。

column1: There are a few unbroken bottles remaining in this dead man's satchel.
column2: 这个死人的背包里还剩几只没碎的瓶子。

column1: There is a mangled, scraggy tree standing here with barely any branches on it.
column2: 这里立着一棵扭曲、枯瘦的树，上面几乎没有树枝。

column1: This man is dressed in rags. His eyes are sparks of bloody red, and his lips are pulled taut by large fangs. It is very obvious that he is a vampire.
column2: 这个男人衣衫褴褛。他的眼睛是血红的火星，嘴唇被巨大的尖牙扯得绷紧。他是吸血鬼，这一点非常明显。

column1: Searching this drawer, you find a long forgotten key in the corner.
column2: 你搜索这个抽屉，在角落里发现一把早已被遗忘的钥匙。

column1: There is something still in the quench barrel.
column2: 淬火桶里还有什么东西。

column1: The smell is reminiscent of the fluid you found when you started exploring Zias.
column2: 这气味让你想起刚开始探索齐亚斯时发现的那种液体。

column1: The patch you are standing on appears to be free-floating. You could push off of this sinew to see where it takes you.
column2: 你脚下这块组织似乎是自由漂浮的。你可以蹬离这根肌腱，看看它会把你带到哪里。

column1: There is a cord of nervous tissue stretched tight between  the floor and the ceiling.
column2: 有一条神经组织的索绷紧着，连接在地板与天花板之间。

column1: There is a cord of nervous tissue stretched tight between the floor and the ceiling.
column2: 有一条神经组织的索绷紧着，连接在地板与天花板之间。

column1: This sinew is blocking your path to the exit.
column2: 这根肌腱挡住了你通向出口的路。

column1: Whatever this nerve was controlling should now be released.
column2: 这条神经原先控制的东西，现在应当已经松开了。

column1: You've hit a membrane of some kind. There is no choice but to head back in the direction you came.
column2: 你撞上了某种膜。别无选择，只能顺着来路返回。

column1: In fact, upon closer inspection, it appears that it's not a tentacle at all, but rather some kind of whip-like weapon.
column2: 事实上，仔细一看，它根本不是触手，而是某种鞭状武器。

column1: Scything blades cut your hands. You might have better luck if you try again.
column2: 镰割的刀刃划伤了你的手。再试一次，你也许会走运些。

column1: There is a vile-smelling liquid filling this basin. You can't see to the bottom, but it looks important.
column2: 这只盆里盛满恶臭的液体。你看不见底，但它看着很重要。

column1: There is obviously a mechanism attached to the hinge on this chest. Try to open it?
column2: 这口箱子的铰链上显然连着机关。要试着打开它吗？

column1: Who knows what could be in there? You leave it alone for now.
column2: 谁知道里面会有什么？你暂时不去碰它。

column1: Withdrawing your hand quickly, you find that the tentacle isn't actually attached to anything, and comes out of the goo readily.
column2: 你迅速抽回手，发现那触手其实没有连在任何东西上，轻易就从黏液里出来了。

column1: You disable the blade trap and pop the chest open.
column2: 你解除了刀刃陷阱，把箱子啪地打开。

column1: You reach inside, and your hand is promptly grabbed by some kind of tentacle!
column2: 你把手伸进去，立刻被某种触手抓住了！

column1: \rHah! You've put some thought into this, I see.
column2: “\r哈！看来你还真把这事想过了。”

column1: Repeat offenders will undergo corporal punishment.\r Resisting arrest, or demonstrating any degree of violence, is punishable by death.
column2: “屡犯者将受肉刑。\r拒捕，或表现出任何程度的暴力，可处死刑。”

column1: The sludge in this cauldron smells positively foul.
column2: 这口大锅里的泥浆臭得要命。

column1: You lift the heavy switch and twist it into the open position.
column2: 你抬起沉重的开关，把它拧到开启的位置。
